त: त The first consonant of the fourth or dental class, corresponding to the letter T, in tongue.

त m. (तः) 1 A thief. 2 Nectar, the food of the immortals. 3 An outcaste, a barbarian or Mleccha. 4 The flank, the hip or haunch. 5 A tail. 6 The womb. 7 A wicked man. 8 A tree. 9 A jewel. 10 A Buddha. n. (तं) 1 Passing, crossing. 2 Virtue, sanctity. E. तृ to cross, &c. affix ड.
तक: तक r. 1st cl. (तकति) 1 To laugh at or deride. 2 To bear. With वि and अति prefixed, and implying reciprocity (ष्यतितकते) To retort a laugh. (इ) तकि r. 1st cl. (तङ्कति) To live in distress, to be in poverty or pain. (तंकते) To go, to move.
तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) That. E. तत् that, कन् pleonasm added.
तकिल: तकिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fraudulent, crafty, a rogue or cheat. f. (-ला) A medicament, a drug. E. तक to deride, affix इलच्
तक्य: तक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) 1 Laughable, ridiculous. 2 To be borne or endured. E. तक to laugh, यत् participial aff.
तक्र: तक्र n. (-क्रं) Buttermilk with a fourth part water. E. तक to bear (sickness), Uṇādi affix रक्.
तक्रकूर्चिका: तक्रकूर्च्चिका f. (-का) Inspissated buttermilk. E. तक्र, and कूर्च्चिका inspissated milk.
तक्रकूर्च्चिका: तक्रकूर्च्चिका f. (-का) Inspissated buttermilk. E. तक्र, and कूर्च्चिका inspissated milk.
तक्रमांस: तक्रमांस n. (-सं) Meat fried with ghee, turmeric and asafœtida, &c. eaten with buttermilk. E. तक्र, and मांस flesh.
तक्राट: तक्राट m. (-टः) A churning-stick. E. तक्र buttermilk, and अट what goes or is, (from it.)
तक्ष: तक्ष r. 1st cl. (तक्षति) 1 To cover. 2 To skin or peel. (ऊ) तक्षू r. 1st cl. (तक्ष्णोति) To pare, to plane, to make thin, to cut off, to chip or slice; used in any other sense, this root takes the regular form only, whether simple or compound, as with सम् prefixed, To censure, (सन्तक्षति,) &c.
तक्षक: तक्षक m. (-कः) 1 A carpenter. 2 The Sūtradhāra, the manager and chief actor in the prelude of a drama. 3 One of the principal Nāgas or serpents of Pātāla. 4 The divine artist, VIŚVAKARMA. 5 The name of a tree. E. तक्ष to chip, to peel or plane, &c. affix वुन्.
तक्षण: तक्षण n. (-णं) Paring, peeling, planing, &c. f. (-णी) A carpenter's adze. E. तक्ष to plane or pare, affix ल्युट् and ङीष्.
तक्षन्: तक्षन् m. (-क्षा) A carpenter. E. तक्ष to pare, Uṇādi affix कनिन्.
तक्षशिला: तक्षशिला f. (-ला) The name of a city, the Taxila of Ptolemy, in the Punjab. E. तक्ष paring, शिला stone, built of hewn stones.
तग: तग (इ) तगि r. 1st cl. (तंगति) 1 To go or move. 2 To quake, to shake or tremble. 3 To trip, to stumble.
तगर: तगर m. (-रः) 1 A shrub, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.) 2 A thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.) 3 Another plant, commonly Tagaramūla.
तगरपादिका: तगरपादिका f. (-का) A plant; also Tagaramūla.
तङ्क: तङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 An axe, a crow, a stonecutter's chisel: see तङ्क. 2 Grief upon separation from a beloved object. 3 Fear, terror. E. तकि to be in distress, &c. affix अच्.
तज्ज: तज्ज mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं) Immediate, instantaneous. E. तत् that, (that moment,) and ज born.
तञ्च: तञ्च उ) तञ्चु r. 1st cl. (तञ्चति) To go. (ऊ) तञ्चू r. 7th cl. (तनक्ति) To shrink or contract; also तञ्ज.
तञ्ज: तञ्ज उ) तञ्जू r. 7th cl. (तनक्ति) To shrink or contract.
तट: तट r. 1st cl. (तटति) To be elevated or high, to rise. r. 10th cl. (ताटयति) To beat.
तट mfn. sub. (-टः-टा-टी-टं) A shore or bank. n. (-टं) A field. E. तट to rise or be high, affix अच्, fem. aff. ङीप्.
तटस्थ: तटस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Indifferent, alien, neuter. 2 Situated on the bank or shore. m. (-स्थः) An indifferent person, one neither a friend nor a foe. n. (-स्थं) That property which is distinct from the nature of any thing, yet is the faculty by which it is known: in other words, spiritual essence unconnected with bodily wants or passions. E. तट a bank, a height, and स्थ who stands.
तटाक: तटाक m. (-कः) A pond deep enough for the lotus and other aquatic flowers. E. तट a bank, and अक to go, affix अच्; also तडाक; also ताटाक and तटीक.
तटिनी: तटिनी f. (-नी) A river. E. तट a bank, and इनि poss. aff.
तड: तड r. 10th cl. (ताडयति) 1 To beat, to strike. 2 To shine: (इ) तडि r. 1st cl. (तण्डते) To strike or beat.
तडग: तडग m. (-गः) A pond, a tank: see तडाग.
तडाक: तडाक m. (-कः) A pond or pool, one deep enough for the lotus, &c. f. (-का) 1 A bank, a shore. 2 A blow. E. तड to beat, Uṇādi affix आक; also तटाक and तडाग.
तडाग: तडाग m. (-गः) 1 A pond, a pool, deep enough for the growth of the lotus, &c. see the preceding. 2 A trap for catching deer, &c. E. तड to beat, affix आग, deriv. irr.
तडाघात: तडाघात m. (-तः) A blow from an elephant's uplifted trunk. E. तडा a beating, and आघात a blow.
तडित्: तडित् f. (-डित्) Lightning. E. तड to strike or beat, Uṇādi affix इति; striking the earth, &c.
तडित्वत्: तडित्वत् mfn. (-त्वान्-त्वती-त्वत्) Lightening, emitting lightning, flashing. m. (-त्वान्) A cloud. E. तडित्, lightning, and मतुप् aff.
तडिल्लता: तडिल्लता f. (-ता) Forked lightning. E. तडित्, and लता a creeper.
तण्डक: तण्डक mn. (-कः-कं) Complete performance or preparation. m. (-कः) 1 A wag-tail. 2 Froth, foam. 3 The trunk of a tree. 4 The upright post of a house. 5 A compound word. 6 A juggler, a cheat. E. तडि to beat or kill, affix वुन्.
तण्डु: तण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) One of ŚIVA'S doorkeepers, and one of the original teachers of the arts of dancing and mimicry.
तण्डुरीण: तण्डुरीण m. (-णः) 1 A worm, an insect. 2 A fool, a blockhead. 3 The water in which rice has been soaked or steeped. E. तण्डुल rice, &c. ख affix, and ल changed to र.
तण्डुल: तण्डुल m. (-लः) 1 Grain after threshing and winnowing, especially rice. 2 A vermifuge plant: see विडङ्ग. 3 A potherb, a sort of Amaranth, (A. polygonoides.) E. तड to beat, Uṇādi affix उल, and नुम् inserted.
तण्डुलाम्बु: तण्डुलाम्बु f. (-म्बुः) Rice water or gruel. E. तण्डुल, and अम्बु water.
तण्डुलीक: तण्डुलीक m. (-कः) A sort of Amaranth. E. ईकन् added to the preceding; also तण्डुलीय.
तण्डुलीय: तण्डुलीय m. (-यः) 1 A kind of Amaranth, (A. polygonoides.) 2 Viraṅga, a vermifuge. 3 A mineral, iron pyrites. E. तण्डुल grain, (to which the seeds, &c. are compared,) and छ affix; also तण्डुलीयक.
तण्डुलु: तण्डुलु f. (-लुः) A plant of which the seeds are used as a vermifuge: see विडङ्ग. E. तडि to beat, affix उलु.
तण्डुलेर: तण्डुलेर m. (-रः) A sort of Amaranth: see तण्डुलीय, &c. E. तण्डुल, and एरक् aff.
तण्डुलोदक: तण्डुलोदक n. (-कं) Water in which rice has been boiled, rice gruel. E. तण्डुल, and उदक water.
तण्डुलौघ: तण्डुलौघ m. (-घः) A prickly sort of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa.) 2 A heap of grain. E. तण्डुल grain, &c. or (as derived from तडि to beat, to tear,) a thorn, ओघ a heap or quantity.
तत्: तत् ind. Therefore, thence, the consequent or correlative to यत्. E. तन to spread or extend, affix क्विप्.
ततःप्रभृति: ततःप्रभृति ind. Thenceforth. E. ततस्, and प्रभृति the rest.
तत: तत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Spread, diffused, expanded. 2 Stretched, extended. m. (-तः) Air, wind. n. (-तं) Any stringed musical instrument. E. तन to spread, &c. क्त affix, or Uṇādi affix तन्.
ततचिह्न: ततचिह्न mfn. (-ह्नः-ह्ना-ह्नं) Distinctly marked. E. तत, and चिह्न a mark.
ततपत्री: ततपत्री f. (-त्री) The plantain tree. E. तत spread, and पत्री a leaf, broad-leaved.
ततम: ततम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) That one, (of many.) E. तद् that, डतमच् affix of the superlative degree.
ततर: ततर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) That one, (of two.) E. तद् that, and डतरच् affix of the comparative degree.
ततस्: ततस् ind. 1 Therefore, thence, consequently. 2 From that or then. 3 Then, how, (asking.) 4 Then, further, after that, (in continuation.) 5 Afterwards, subsequently. 6 Thither, there. E. तद् that, affix तसि.
ततस्ततस्: ततस्ततस् ind. 1 Hither and thither. 2 Then, after that, what next; (asking impatiently.) E. ततस् reiterated.
ततस्त्य: ततस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) Of or relating to that, &c. E. ततस् as above, त्यप् aff.
तति: तति mfn. plu. (ततयः ततयः ततीनि) So many.
तति f. (-तिः) 1 A line, a row or range. 2 A number, a crowd, E. तन to spread, affix क्तिन्.
तत्कर: तत्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Obeying, serving, a servant. E. तद्, and कर who does.
तत्काल: तत्काल m. (-लः) Present time, time being, or the time when an, act occurs. E. तत् that, काल time.
तत्कालधी: तत्कालधी m. (-धीः) A man wise or intelligent for the time being, one having presence of mind, &c. E. तत्काल time being, and धी understanding.
तत्क्रिय: तत्क्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Working without hire or wages. E. तत् thence, क्रिया business.
तत्क्षण: तत्क्षण n. (-णं) Time present, time being. E. तद् that, and क्षण moment.
तत्त्व: तत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) 1 Essential nature, the real nature of the human soul, considered as one and the same with the divine spirit animating the universe: the philosophical etymology of this word best explains its meaning, तद् that, that divine being, and त्व thou, that very God art thou. 2 The Supreme Being, or BRAHMA. 3 Truth, reality, substance, opposed to what is illusory or fallacious. 4 An element or elementary property, differently enumerated in different systems, from the three which are the same with the three Guṇas, to twenty-seven, which include the elements, organs, faculties, matter, spirit, life, and God. 5 A first principle, an axiom. 6 Mind, intellect. 7 Slow time in music. 8 A musical instrument. E. as above, or तद that, thence, &c. affix त्व; the word is properly, therefore, written तत्त्व, but in books one त is commonly rejected.
तत्त्वज्ञान: तत्त्वज्ञान n. (-नं) Knowledge of divine truth. E. तत्त्व as above, and ज्ञान knowledge.
तत्त्वतस्: तत्त्वतस् ind. Truly, accurately, fully. E. तत्त्व, and तसिल् aff.
तत्त्वन्यास: तत्त्वन्यास m. (-सः) Touching different parts of the body in the worship of VIṢṆU. E. तत्त्व, and न्यास gesticulation.
तत्त्वविद्: तत्त्वविद् mfn. (-वित्) Knowing the truth, knowing things as they are. E. तत्त्व, and विद् who knows.
तत्त्वावबोध: तत्त्वावबोध m. (-धः) Knowledge of spirit. E. तत्त्व, and अवबोध ascertainment.
तत्त्वाभियोग: तत्त्वाभियोग m. (-गः) A positive charge or declaration. E. तत्त्व, and अभियोग accusation.
तत्पर: तत्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Diligent, attending to any thing closely and anxiously. 2 Belonging to a principal object or intent of. m. (-रः) The thirtieth part of the time of the twinkling of the eye. E. तत् that, पर addicted to.
तत्परायण: तत्परायण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Attached or addicted to some particular thing or person. E. तद् that, परायण attached to.
तत्पूर्व: तत्पूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Prior, former. E. तत्, and पूर्व्व before.
तत्पूर्व्व: तत्पूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Prior, former. E. तत्, and पूर्व्व before.
तत्पुरुष: तत्पुरुष m. (-षः) 1 That or a certain person. 2 A form of composition, (in Grammar,) usually consisting of two nouns, the first of which was in any case except the nominative or vocative; sometimes the inflection of the case is retained. E. तत् that, and पुरुष man or person.
तत्फल: तत्फल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Resulting from any particular act, &c. m. (-लः) 1 The white-water lily. 3 A fragrant grass. E. तद्, and फल fruit.
तत्र: तत्र (इ) तत्रि r. 10th cl. (तन्त्रयति) 1 To spread, to extend or expand. 2 To nourish or support a family, &c.
तत्र ind. There, therein, the relative to अत्र. E. तद् that, त्रल् affix, in lieu of the proper seventh case.
तत्रत्य: तत्रत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Produced there or in a certain place. E. तत्र, and त्यप् aff.
तत्रभवत्: तत्रभवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Venerable, respectable, reverend. E. तत्र therein, (in all things,) भवत् preeminent: see अत्रभवत्.
तथा: तथा ind. 1 So, like, correlative to यथा as, &c. 2 Thus, (implying certainty.) 3 So, so be it, (implying assent or promise.) 4 Thus, then, therefore, (or reply.) 5 And, so, in (conjunction.) E. तद् that, थाल affix, implying manner.
तथागत: तथागत m. (-तः) A Jina or Buddha. E. तथा thus, (what really is,) and गत known, obtained.
तथाच: तथाच ind. And so, thus, even so. E. तथा, with च and.
तथात्व: तथात्व n. (-त्वं) Being so; the case or circumstances being admitted to be as stated. E. तथा, and त्व aff.
तथापि: तथापि ind. Nevertheless, yet, even. E. तथा, and अपि even.
तथाविध: तथाविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Of such a sort or kind. E. तथा, and विध sort.
तथाराज: तथाराज m. (-जः) A Jina or Buddha.
तथैव: तथैव ind. So, even so, in the same manner. E. तथा, and एव thus.
तथ्य: तथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) True. n. (-थ्यं) Truth. E. तथा thus, (what, is really so,) and यत् aff.
तद्: तद् Relative or third personal pronoun, (सः सा तद्) He, she, it, that man, that woman, that thing. E. तन to extend or spread, Uṇādi affix अदि.
तद: तद (इ) तदि r. 1st cl. (तन्दते) To be content or happy.
तदतिपात: तदतिपात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Transgressing, going beyond the bounds.
तदनन्तर: तदनन्तर n. adv. (-रं) Next, afterwards. E. तत् that, अनन्तर after.
तदन्त: तदन्त n. adv. (-न्तं) To that end, just so far. E. तद, and अन्त end.
तदर्थ: तदर्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 On that account, with that object. 2 Having such a meaning. E. तद्, and अर्थ sense.
तदर्पण: तदर्पण n. (-णं) 1 A thing returned. 2 Delivering any article. E. तद, and अर्पण delivery.
तदा: तदा ind. Then, at that time. E. तद् that, दाच affix, implying time.
तदात्व: तदात्व n. (-त्वं) Time being, time present. E. तदा then, त्व affix of the abstract.
तदानीम्: तदानीम् ind. Then, at that time. E. तद that, दानीम् aff.
तदाप्रभृति: तदाप्रभृति ind. Thenceforward. E. तदा, and प्रभृति the rest.
तदामुख: तदामुख n. (-खं) Commencement, beginning. E. तदा, and मुख beginning.
तदीय: तदीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) That, that person, that thing. E. तद्, and छ aff.
तद्दिनम्: तद्दिनम् ind. 1 In the course of the day. 2 Day by day. n. (-नं) On a certain day. E. तद् that, and दिन a day.
तद्धन: तद्धन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Miserly, niggardly. E. तत् thence, धन wealth.
तद्वत्: तद्वत् ind. So, in like manner, the correlative to यद्वत् as. E. तद् that, वति aff.
तद्वला: तद्वला f. (-ला) A sort of arrow. E. तत् thence, वल strong.
तद्विध: तद्विध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) In that manner, in such a manner, of such a kind or sort. E. तद्, and विध way.
तद्धित: तद्धित m. (-तः) A derivative noun, as a patronymic or attributive of various kinds, &c. n. (-तं) The formation of such nouns. E. तत् that, (original noun,) हित what relates to or suits.
तन: तन (उ) तनु r. 8th cl. (तनोति-तनुते) To expand, to spread, to extend, to diffuse, to dilate, &c. physically or morally. r. 1st and 10th cls. (तनति तानयति) 1 To confide, to believe or have faith in. 2 To aid, to assist. 3 To be harmless. 4 To sound. 5 To pain or afflict with disease. 6 (With a preposition,) To lengthen, to stretch, to expand, &c. as in the 8th cl.
तनय: तनय m. (-यः) 1 A son. 2 A male descendant. f. (-या) 1 A daughter. 2 A plant: see चक्रकुल्या. E. तन to spread, (to extend the family or name,) कयन् Uṇādi aff.
तनिष्ठ: तनिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Smaller, less. 2 Minute, delicate, small. E. तनु, and इष्ठन् aff.
तनीयस्: तनीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Smallest, least. 2 Very small or delicate, &c. E. तुनु, and ईयसुन् aff.
तनु: तनु mfn. (-नुः-नुः or न्वी or नूः-नु) 1 Small, minute. 2 Delicate, fine, but with interstices. 3 Thin, slender, emaciated. 4 Little. f. (-नुः-नूः) 1 The body. 2 The skin. f. (नुः) 1 A woman. 2 Point of conjunction, or sun's entrance into a new sign. f. (-न्वी) 1 A delicate or slender woman. 2 A stanza of four lines, and twenty-four syllables in each: a variety of the Saṃkṛti metre. E. तन to stretch or spread, Uṇādi affix उ; also तनू and तनुस्.
तनुकूप: तनुकूप m. (-पः) A pore of the skin. E. तनु, and कूप a well.
तनुच्छद्: तनुच्छद् mfn. (-छत्) Covering (the body,) clothing, protecting. f. (-छत्) 1 Armour. 2 Attire. E. तनु, and छद to cover, affix क्विप्.
तनुज: तनुज m. (-जः) A son. f. (-जा) A daughter. E. तनु body, and ज born.
तनुत्र: तनुत्र n. (-त्रं) Armour, mail. E. तनु the body, and त्र what preserves; also तनुत्राण (-णं.)
तनुत्रवत्: तनुत्रवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Armed, defended. E. तनुत्र, and मतुप् aff.
तनुत्याग: तनुत्याग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Niggardly, sparing, letting little go or be spent. m. (-गः) Quitting the body, death. E. तवु little or the body, त्याग parting with.
तनुभस्त्रा: तनुभस्त्रा f. (-स्त्रा) The nose. E. तनु the body, and भस्वा a bellows.
तनुमत्: तनुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Embodied, corporeal. E. तनु, and मतुप् aff.
तनुमध्या: तनुमध्या f. (-ध्या) 1 A woman with a slender or elegant waist. 2 A species of the Gāyatrī metre. E. तनु, and मध्य middle.
तनुरस: तनुरस m. (-सः) Perspiration, sweat. E. तनु the body, and रस juice.
तनुरुह: तनुरुह n. (-हं) The hair or down of the body. E. तनु, and रुह what grows: also with the final consonant. तनुरुह् n. (-रुट्)
तनुल: तनुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Spread, expanded. E. तनु to spread, उलच् Uṇādi aff.
तनुवात: तनुवात m. (-तः) A division of hell. E. तनु thin, small, and वात wind.
तनुवार: तनुवार n. (-रं) Armour. E. तनु, वृ to defend, अण् aff.
तनुवारभस: तनुवारभस m. (-सः) A warrior, a man in armour. E. तनुवार, and भस who shines.
तनुव्रण: तनुव्रण m. (-णः) A pimple, a pustule, a boil. E. तनु slight, and व्रण a sore.
तनुस्: तनुस् n. (-नुः) The body. E. तन to stretch, Uṇādi affix उसि.
तनुसञ्चारिणी: तनुसञ्चारिणी f. (-णी) A young woman, a girl, one of ten years old. E. तनु the body, सञ्चारिणी who makes perfect.
तनू: तनू f. (-नूः) The body. E. तन to stretch, affix ऊः see तनु.
तनूकृत: तनूकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pared, made delicate or thin. E. तनु thin, कृत made, and उ rendered long.
तनूज: तनूज m. (-जः) A son. f. (-जा) A daughter. E. तनू, and ज born.
तनूजनि: तनूजनि m. (-निः) A son. E. तनू, and जनि birth.
तनून: तनून m. (-नः) the wind. E. तनु body, ऊन defective.
तनूनप: तनूनप n. (-पं) Clarified butter or ghee. E. तनु the body, and ऊन deficiency, thinness, spareness of body, and प what cherishes; what fattens.
तनूनपाद्: तनूनपाद् m. (-पाद् or पात्) Fire or its deity. E. तनूनप ghee, and अद् who eats, from अद with विच् affix, or तनू the body, न negative, and पा to preserve, deriv. irr. destroying other bodies, or consuming its own support or fuel, and ceasing to be.
तनूरुह: तनूरुह mn. (-हः-हं) 1 The hair of the body. 2 The wing of a bird. m. (-हः) A son. E. तनु or तनू the body, and रुह what grows or rises, from रुह with क affix; also तनुरुह.
तनूह्रद: तनूह्रद m. (-दः) The anus, the rectum. E. तनू the body, and ह्रद a deep place.
तन्ति: तन्ति m. (-न्तिः) A weaver. f. (-न्तिः) Expansion, extension. E. तन to stretch, affix क्तिच्.
तन्तु: तन्तु m. (-न्तुः) 1 A thread. 2 A shark. 3 Offspring, race, descendants. E. तन to spread or stretch, Uṇādi affix तुन्.
तन्तुक: तन्तुक m. (-कः) Mustard seed. f. (-की) A vein or any tubular vessel: see तन्तुभ.
तन्तुकाष्ठ: तन्तुकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A piece of fibrous wood, or a brush used by weavers for cleaning the threads of the woof. E. तन्तु a weaver's thread, and काष्ठ a woof.
तन्तुकीट: तन्तुकीट m. (-टः) A silk worm. E. तन्तु a thread, and कीट a worm.
तन्तुण: तन्तुण m. (-णः) A shark. E. तन to spread, तुण aff.
तन्तुनाग: तन्तुनाग m. (-गः) A shark. E. तन्तु, and नाग a snake.
तन्तुनिर्यास: तन्तुनिर्यास m. (-सः) A palmyra tree. E. तन्तु thread, and निर्यास exudation, alluding to its stringy or adhesive nature.
तन्तुपर्वन्: तन्तुपर्व्वन् n. (-र्व्व) The full moon of Śrāvaṇa, when KṚṢṆA is invested with the Brahmanical cord. E. तन्तु, and पर्व्वन् a festival.
तन्तुपर्व्वन्: तन्तुपर्व्वन् n. (-र्व्व) The full moon of Śrāvaṇa, when KṚṢṆA is invested with the Brahmanical cord. E. तन्तु, and पर्व्वन् a festival.
तन्तुभ: तन्तुभ m. (-भः) 1 Mustard seed, (Sinapis dichotoma;) also sometimes तन्तुका. 2 A calf. E. तन्तु a thread, and भा to shine, affix क.
तन्तुल: तन्तुल n. (-लं) The filaments or fibrous root of the lotus. E. तन्तु a thread, and ल what has; also with र, तन्तुर.
तन्तुवाप: तन्तुवाप m. (-पः) 1 A weaver. 2 A loom. E. तन्तु a thread, वप to weave, affix घञ्.
तन्तुवाय: तन्तुवाय m. (-यः) 1 A weaver. 2 A spider. E. तन्तु a thread, वे to weave, अण् affix; also तन्त्रवाय.
तन्तुविग्रहा: तन्तुविग्रहा f. (-हा) The banana or plantain. E. तन्तु a thread, and विग्रह a part.
तन्तुशाला: तन्तुशाला f. (-ला) A weaver's shop. E. तन्तु weaving, and शाला a house or hall.
तन्तुसन्तत: तन्तुसन्तत n. (-तं) Wove cloth. E. तन्तु a thread, and सन्तत collected.
तन्तुसार: तन्तुसार m. (-रः) The betel-nut tree; also तन्तुसारक. E. तन्तु a thread, and सार pith; having a stringy pith.
तन्त्र: तन्त्र mfn. (न्त्रः-न्त्रा-न्त्रं) Dependant, subservient. m. (-न्त्रः) A weaver. f. (-न्त्री) 1 Any string or rope. 2 The wire or string of a lute. 3 Any tubular vessel of the body. 4 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum:) see गूडुची. 5 The name of a river. 6 A young woman. n. (-न्त्रं) 1 A Tantra, a religious treatise teaching peculiar and mystical formulæ and rites for the worship of the deities, or the attainment of superhuman power: it is mostly in the form of a dialogue between ŚIVA and DURGĀ, who are the peculiar gods of the Tāntrikas: there is a great number of these works, and their authority, in many parts of India, seems to have, in a great measure, superseded that of the Vedas: according to one account, a Tantra comprises five subjects, the creation and destruction of the world, the worship of the gods, the attainment of all objects, magical rites for the acquirement of six (superhuman) faculties, and four modes of union with spirit by meditation; a variety of subjects are, however, introduced into many of them, whilst some are limited to a single topic, as the mode of breathing in certain rites, the language of birds, beasts, &c. 2 A branch of the Vedas, that which teaches Mantras or mystical and magical formula. 3 Demonstration, clear and right conclusion. 4 Raiment, vesture. 5 A medicament, a drug. 6 A principal medicament, or perhaps a charm, considered as producing medicinal effects. 7 Providing for a family. 8 A cause, a motive. 9 Cause common to two or more results; the instruments or means of more than one effect. 10 Necessary or indispensable act or provision; the right way of doing any thing. 11 Chief, principal. 12 A royal retinue, a court, a train. 13 An army. 14 A royal property; that of providing for the security and prosperity of the kingdom. 15 A realm, a country. 16 A thread. 17 Subservience, service, dependance. 18 Oath or ordeal. 19 Decorations, hanging with trophies, garlands, &c. 20 Heap, multitude. 21 Wealth. 22 A house. 23 An implement of weaving, a loom. 24 Happiness, felicity. E. तन to spread or extend, affix ष्ट्रन्; or तत्रि to spread, to support a family, &c. affix क, fem. affix ङीप्; or तत्त्र with ई Uṇādi aff.
तन्त्रक: तन्त्रक n. (-कं) New and unbleached cloth. E. तन्त्र the loom, and कन् affix, recently from the loom.
तन्त्रकाष्ठ: तन्त्रकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A fibrous stick for cleaning the woof, &c. E. तन्त्र weaving, and काष्ठ wood.
तन्त्रता: तन्त्रता f. (-ता) 1 Dependance, subservience. 2 The quality or character of a Tantra. 3 Comprehending several rites in one, performance of one ceremony or penance in lieu of a number. E. तत्त्र, and तल् added; also with त्व, तन्त्रत्व.
तन्त्रवाप: तन्त्रवाप m. (-पः) A weaver. mn. (-पः-पं) A loom. E. तन्त्र a thread, and वप to weave, affix घञ्.
तन्त्रवाय: तन्त्रवाय m. (-यः) 1 A weaver. 2 A spider. E. तन्त्र a thread, a web, and वे to spin or weave, affix घञ्; also तन्त्रवाप, and sometimes तन्द्रवाय.
तन्त्रिका: तन्त्रिका f. (-का) A plant, Guricha. E. कन् added to तन्त्री.
तन्त्रिन्: तन्त्रिन् mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि) 1 Spun, wove, made of threads. 2 Chorded, having chords or wires, (as an instrument.) 3 A musician. 4 Having a Tantra, following one, &c. E. तन्त्र, and इनि aff.
तन्त्रिपालक: तन्त्रिपालक m. (-कः) A name of JAYADRATHA. E. तन्त्रि (derived from तन्त्र any army, with इनि affix,) a general, and पालक who cherishes or aids.
तन्द्रवाय: तन्द्रवाय m. (-यः) A weaver: see तन्त्रवाय.
तन्द्रा: तन्द्रा f. (-न्द्रा) 1 Lassitude, exhaustion, weariness, syncope. 2 Sleepiness, sluggishness. E. तन्द्रि a Sautra root, to be weary, affixes क and टाप्; also with क्तिन् affix तन्द्रि. f. (-न्द्रिः) and with ङीष् added तन्द्री.
तन्द्रालु: तन्द्रालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Slothful, sluggish, overcome with sleep or fatigue. E. तन्द्र sloth, and आलुच् aff.
तन्द्रि: तन्द्रि f. (-न्द्रिः) 1 Sleepiness. 2 Lassitude. 3 Fainting, exhaustion: see तन्द्रा. E. as above, or तदि Sautra root, to be weary, and क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.
तन्द्रिका: तन्द्रिका f. (-का) Sloth, sleepiness. E. कन् added to तन्द्री.
तन्द्री: तन्द्री f. (-न्द्री) 1 Drowsiness. 2 Lassitude: see तन्द्रा.
तन्नि: तन्नि f. (-न्निः) A plant: see चक्रकुल्या.
तन्मात्र: तन्मात्र n. sub. (-त्रं) The archetype or subtile rudiment of elementary matter. adv. Merely that. E. तद्, and मात्र only, or element.
तन्यतु: तन्यतु m. (-तुः) 1 Night. 2 A musical instrument. E. तन to spread, यतुच् Uṇādi aff.
तन्वत्: तन्वत् mfn. (-न्वत्-न्वन्ती-न्वत्) Spreading, extending. E. तन to spread, शतृ aff.
तप: तप (औ) तपौ r. 1st cl. (तपति-ते) r. 4th cl. (तप्यति-ते) and r. 10th cl.  (तापयति-ते) 1 To heat or be hot, to burn; (hence figuratively,) to suffer mental or bodily pain. 2 To have pre-eminent or superhuman power: the deponent form only is used when the root with the prefix उत् or वि occurs intransitively, or governs as its object part of the body of the agent, as पाणिं वितपते warms the hand, (उत्तपते वितपते) shines, burns, &c. The root takes the passive form also, when implying religious meditation, as तप्यते तपस्तापसः the devotee revolves religious thoughts. With अनु prefixed, (अनुतपते) To repent, to regret. With परि or सम् (परितपति सन्तपति,) 1 To bear or inflict pain, anguish, heat, distress, &c. 2 To be sorrowful, to repent.
तप m. (-पः) 1 The hot season, summer. 2 Heat, warmth. 3 The sun. E. तप to heat, affix अच्.
तपःकर: तपःकर m. (-रः) The mango fish: see तपस्विन्.
तपःकृश: तपःकृश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Emaciated by austerities. E. तपस्, and कृश lean.
तपःक्लेशसह: तपःक्लेशसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Patient of austerities. E. तपस् austere devotion, क्लश fatigue, and सह bearing.
तपःस्थली: तपःस्थली f. (-ली) A name of Benāres. E. तपस् religious austerities, and स्थल soil, place, fem. affix ङीष्.
तपत्: तपत् mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्) 1 Heating or warming. 2 Performing penance. E. तप to heat, शतृ aff.
तपती: तपती f. (-ती) 1 A name of CHĀYĀ, wife of the sun. 2 Also of the daughter of the sun, or the personified Taptī river, married to SAṂVARAṆA of the Kuru family. E. तप heat or the sun, and अत who accompanies, fem. affix ङीष्.
तपन: तपन m. (-तः) 1 The sun. 2 A division of hell. 3 Heat, burning. 4 Mental distress, pining, grieving. 5 The hot season. 6 The marking nut plant. f. (-नी) The Godāvarī river. E. तप to inflame, affixes ल्युट् and ङीष्.
तपनकर: तपनकर m. (-रः) A ray, a sun-beam. E. तपन, and कर a ray.
तपनतनय: तपनतनय m. (-यः) KARṆA, &c. f. (-या) 1 The Yamunā river. 2 The Tapti. E. तपन, the sun, and तनय child.
तपनमणि: तपनमणि m. (-णिः) The sun-stone. E. तपन, and मणि a gem.
तपनांशु: तपनांशु m. (-शुः) A ray of the sun, a sun-beam. E. तपन, and अंशु ray.
तपनात्मजा: तपनात्मजा f. (-जा) 1 The Godāvarī river. 2 The Yamunā or Jumna river. E. तपन the sun, and आत्मजा a daughter.
तपनीय: तपनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be heated. 2 To be suffered or practised as penance. n. (-यं) Gold. E. तप to heat, &c. अनीयर् aff.
तपनीयक: तपनीयक n. (-कं) Gold. E. तपनीय, and कन् added.
तपनेष्ट: तपनेष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Copper. E. तपन, and इष्ट liked.
तपस्: तपस् m. (-पाः) 1 The name of a month, Māgha, (January-February.) 2 The cold or dewy season. 3 The hot season. n. (-पः) 1 Religious austerity, penance, mortification, the practice of mental or personal self-denial, or the infliction of bodily tortures. 2 A world, the region above the Janaloka, inhabited by saints or devotees after death. 3 Virtue, moral merit. 4 Duty, the special observance of certain things: thus the Tapas of a Brahman is sacred learning; of a Kṣatriya, the protection of subjects; of a Vaiśya, almsgiving to Brahmans; of a Śūdra, the service of the same tribe; and of a Ṛṣi or saint, feeding upon herbs and roots. E. तप to heat or inflame, affix असुन.
तपस: तपस m. (-सः) 1 The moon. 2 A bird. E. तप to heat, असच् Uṇādi aff.
तपस्तक्ष: तपस्तक्ष m. (-क्षः) A name of INDRA. E. तपम् austerity, and तक्ष who pares or makes thin; emaciating himself by his devotions.
तपस्य: तपस्य m. (-स्यः) 1 The month Phālguna, (February-March.) A name of ARJUNA. f. (-स्या) 1 Devout austerity, religious penance. n. (-स्यं) The flower of the Kunda, (Jasminum pubescens.) E. तपस् the cold season, यत् aff.
तपस्विन्: तपस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 1 Devout, practising austerities. 2 Poor, wretched, pitiable. m. (-स्वी) 1 An ascetic, a religious man engaged in the practice of rigorous and devout penance. 2 A name of NĀRADA. 3 A mendicant, a pauper. 4 The mango fish (Polynemus risua.) f. (-स्विनी) 1 A female devotee, a woman leading a religious life. 2 Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) 3 Another plant: see कटुरोहिणी. E. तपस् religious austerity, the hot season, &c. विनि aff.
तपस्समाधि: तपस्समाधि m. (-धिः) The practice of penance. E. तपस्, and समाधि obligation.
तपात्मक: तपात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Practising austerities. E. तप, and आत्मक self.
तपात्यय: तपात्यय m. (-यः) The rainy season. E. तप the warm season, and अत्यय destroying; following the hot weather.
तपित: तपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heated, burnt. E. तप to heat, affix क्त, with इट् inserted.
तपुस्: तपुस् m. (-पुः) 1 Fire. 1 The sun. E. तप to heat, Uṇādi affix उसि,
तपोधन: तपोधन m. (-नः) A devotee, an ascetic, one who performs religious penance. f. (-ना) A plant: see मुण्डीरी. E. तपस् religious austerity, and धन wealth.
तपोनुभाव: तपोनुभाव m. (-वः) The influence of religious penance. E. तपस, and अनुभाव authority.
तपोनिष्ठ: तपोनिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Performing penance, practising austerities. E. तपस्, and निष्ठ engaged in.
तपोमय: तपोमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Devout, practising austerities. E. तपस्, and मयट् aff.
तपोमूर्ति: तपोमूर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः) An ascetic. E. तपस्, and मूर्त्ति form.
तपोमूर्त्ति: तपोमूर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः) An ascetic. E. तपस्, and मूर्त्ति form.
तपोराशि: तपोराशि m. (-शिः) An ascetic. E. तपस्, and राशि a heap.
तपोवट: तपोवट m. (-टः) A country, part of central India or holy land, E. तपस् religious austerity, and वट what surrounds.
तपोवन: तपोवन n. (-नं) A sacred grove, a place frequented by ascetics. E. तपस्, and वन a wood.
तप्त: तप्त mfn. (-प्रः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Heated, inflamed, burnt. 2 Scorched by pain or sorrow, distressed, afflicted. 3 Inflamed with anger, incensed. 4 Undergone or performed as penance. 5 Fused, melted. 6 Burnished. E. तप to heat, क्त aff.
तप्तकुम्भ: तप्तकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A hell. E. तप्त, and कुम्भ a jar.
तप्तकृच्छ्र: तप्तकृच्छ्र n. (-च्छ्रं) A sort of penance, drinking hot water, milk, and ghee for three days each, and inhaling hot air for three days. E. तप्त heated, कृच्छ्र penance.
तप्ततपस्: तप्ततपस् m. (-पाः) An ascetic. E. तप्त, and तपस् penance.
तप्तपाषाणकुण्ड: तप्तपाषाणकुण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A hell. E. तप्त, पाषाण a stone, and कुण्ड a well.
तप्तबालुक: तप्तबालुक m. (-कः) A hell. E. तप्त, and वालुका sand.
तप्तरूपक: तप्तरूपक n. (-कं) Silver. E. तप्त, and रूपक silver.
तप्त्वा: तप्त्वा ind. 1 Having heated. 2 Having performed penance. E. तप, and क्त्वा aff.
तप्स्यत्: तप्स्यत् mfn. (-प्स्यन्-प्स्यन्ती-प्स्यत्) Practising or intending to practise austerities. E. तप to perform penance, शतृ affix, future part.
तमःप्रवेश: तमःप्रवेश m. (-शः) 1 Groping in the dark. 2 Mental indistinctness or aberration. E. तमस्, and प्रवेश entrance.
तमःस्थित: तमःस्थित n. (-तं) A hell, one of the lowest divisions of hell. E. तमस्, and स्थित placed.
तम: तम (इर उ) इर्तमु r. 4th cl. (ताम्यति) 1 To desire. 2 To be distressed in body or mind.

तम m. (-मः) The quality of darkness incident to humanity: see तमस्. mf. (-मः-मा) A tree bearing black blossoms. n. (-मं) 1 Darkness, gloom. 2 The point of the foot. f. (-मा-मी) Night. E. तम to be disturbed, to be fatigued, &c. affixes अच्, and टाप् or ङीष्.
तमङ्गक: तमङ्गक m. (-कः) The flat and projecting roof of a house, a sort of balcony or terrace. E. तम to desire, अङ्गक affix; pleasant, desirable.
तमत: तमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Desirous, cupidinous, longing or hankering after. 2 Wished, desired. E. तम to desire, affix अतच्.
तमप्रभ: तमप्रभ mf. (-भः-भा) A hell, one of the lowermost divisions of the infernal regions. E. तम darkness, and प्रभ what is manifest.
तमर: तमर n. (-रं) Lead. E. तम to be disturbed, affix अरन्.
तमराज: तमराज m. (-जः) A kind of sugar.
तमस्: तमस् n. (-मः) 1 The third of the qualities incident to the state of humanity, the Tama guṇa, or property of darkness, whence proceed folly, ignorance, mental blindness, worldly delusion, &c. 2 Darkness, gloom. 3 Sin. 4 Sorrow, grief. mn. (-माः-मः) Rāhu or the personified ascending node: see राहु. E. तम to be disturbed, and असच् Uṇādi affix; that property by which the mind is troubled, the world perplexed, &c.; also तमम् and तम.
तमस: तमस n. (-सं) 1 Darkness. 2 A city. f. (-सा) a river, the Tamasā or Tonse. E. तम to be disturbed, (daylight, &c.) and असच् aff.
तमस्कल्प: तमस्कल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Like darkness, black, gloomy. E. तमस्, and कल्प aff.
तमस्तति: तमस्तति f. (-तिः) Great or diffusive darkness. E. तमस् darkness, and तति a spreading.
तमस्विन्: तमस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) Dark, gloomy. f. (-नी) 1 Night. 2 Turmeric. E. तमस् darkness, and विनि affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
तमाल: तमाल m. (-लः) 1 The sectarial mark made with Sandal, &c. upon the forehead. 2 The name of a tree bearing black blossoms, (Xanthocymus pictorius, Rox.) 3 A sword, a scymitar or large sacrificial knife. 4 A plant: see वरुण. 5 A black kind of Mimosa. 6 The bark of the bambu. n. (-लं) The leaf of the Laurus cassia. E. तम to be dark or troubled, Uṇādi affix कालन्.
तमालक: तमालक n. (-कं) 1 A sort of potherb, (Marsilea dentata, Rox.) 2 The leaf of the Laurus cassia. mn. (-कः-कं) 1 The bark of a bambu. 2 The Tamāla tree: see the preceding. E. कन् pleonasm, or implying some resemblance, added to तमाल.
तमालपत्र: तमालपत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The Tamāla tree: see तमाल. 2 The Tilaka or sectarial mark on the forehead. 3 The leaf of the Laurus cassia. E. तमाल, and पत्र a leaf: the leaf of the Tamāla, either in fact or resemblance.
तमालिका: तमालिका f. (-का) A district in Bengal, the modern Tumlook. E. तमाल a Tamāla tree, ठन् affix, implying possession; also with an analogous affix इनि, तमालिनी abounding in Tamāla trees.
तमाली: तमाली f. (-ली) A medicinal plant: see ताम्रवल्ली.
तमि: तमि f. (-मिः) Night. E. तम to be weary, इन् affix: see तम and तमी.
तमिन्: तमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Desiring, desirous, wishing. E. तम to desire, घिणुन् aff.
तमिस्र: तमिस्र m. (-स्रः) The dark half of the month, from the full to the change. f. (-स्रा) 1 A dark night, or one during the wane of the moon. 2 Great or extensive darkness. 3 The night of new moon. 4 Any night. n. (-स्रं) 1 Darkness. 2 Anger, wrath. E. तमस darkness, र added, and इ substituted for the penultimate.
तमिस्रपक्ष: तमिस्रपक्ष m. (-क्षः) The fortnight of the moon's wane. E. तमिस्र, and पक्ष a fortnight.
तमोगुण: तमोगुण m. (-णः) The quality of darkness or ignorance. E. तमस्, and गुण property.
तमोघ्न: तमोघ्न m. (-घ्नः) 1 Fire. 2 The sun. 3 The moon. 4 The legislator BUDDHA. 5 VIṢṆU. 6 ŚIVA. E. तमस् darkness, (physical or moral,) and घ्न destroyer.
तमोज्योतिस्: तमोज्योतिस् m. (-तिः) A fire fly. E. तमस् darkness, and ज्योतिस् light.
तमोनुद्: तमोनुद् mfn. (-नुद्) Dispersing darkness. m. (-नुद् or नुत्) 1 Fire. 2 The sun. 3 The moon. 4 A lamp. E. तमस् darkness, नुद to send away or disperse, affix क्विप्; also with क affix तमोनुद.
तमोपह: तमोपह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Lightening, enlightening, removing darkness physical or moral. m. (-हः) 1 The sun. 2 The moon. 3 Fire. 4 A name of Buddha, the founder of the Bauddha sect. E. तमम् darkness, अपह removing, from अप prefixed to हन to kill or destroy, affix ड; also तमोहन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ)
तमोभिद्: तमोभिद् m. (-भिट् or भित्) A fire-fly. E. तमस् darkness, and भिद what penetrates.
तमोभूत: तमोभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dark. 2 Ignorant. E. तमस्, and भूत become.
तमोमय: तमोमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Consisting or composed of darkness, derived from it. E. तमस्, and मयट् aff.
तमोमणि: तमोमणि m. (-णिः) A fire-fly. E. तमस् darkness, मणि a gem.
तमोलिप्ती: तमोलिप्ती f. (-प्ती) The district of Tumlook in Bengal. E. तमस् darkness or sin, and लिप्त soiled, affix ङीष्; a country of which the inhabitants are notoriously depraved.
तमोविकार: तमोविकार m. (-रः) Disease, sickness. E. तमस्, and विकार changed, proceeding from the Tama guṇa.
तमोवृत: तमोवृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Overcome with or influenced by rage, fear, &c. or any of the effects of the property of darkness. 2 Obscured, clouded. E. तमस् as above, and आवृत surrounded.
तमोहर: तमोहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Removing darkness, lightening. m. (-रः) The moon. E. तमस् darkness, and हर who removes.
तम्पा: तम्पा f. (-म्पा) A cow. E. तम to desire, अप affix; also प being changed to ब, तम्बा.
तम्ब: तम्ब r. 1st cl. (तम्बति) To go or move.
तम्बा: तम्बा f. (-म्बा) A cow: see तम्पा.
तय: तय r. 1st cl. (तयते) 1 To go or move. 2 To guard or preserve.
तय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Who or what protects. m. (-यः) Protection. E. तय, and अच् aff.
तर: तर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Who or what passes over or beyond. m. (-रः) 1 Passing over, crossing. 2 A float, a raft. 3 A road. 4 A tree. f. (री) 1 A boat. 2 A club. 3 A clothes basket, a Pitāra. 4 Smoke. 5 A small wooden baling vessel. 6 The end of a garment. E. तॄ to cross, affix अप्, fem. affix ङीष्; also with इन् affix तरि, q. v.
तरक्षु: तरक्षु m. (-क्षुः) A hyena. E. तर a road, and क्षि to annoy, affix डु infesting the road; also with कन् added तरक्षुक. m. (-कः) or with ड affix तरक्ष. m. (-क्षः) but not common.
तरङ्ग: तरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A wave. 2 Cloth or clothes. 3 The gallop of a horse. E. तॄ to pass over or cross, Uṇādi affix अङ्गच्.
तरङ्गिणी: तरङ्गिणी f. (-णी) A river. E. तरङ्ग a wave, इनि and ङीष् affs.
तरङ्गित: तरङ्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wavy, billowy, tossing with waves. E. तरङ्ग, and इतच् aff.
तरण: तरण m. (-णः) 1 A raft, a float. 2 Svarga or paradise. n. (-णं) 1 Crossing over, passing, going across. 2 Removing from an inundation. E. तॄ to cross, affix ल्युट्.
तरणि: तरणि m. (-णिः) 1 The sun. 2 A ray of light. 3 A float or raft. f. (-णिः or णी) 1 A boat. The Socotrine aloe, (A. perfoliata.) 3 A plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) E. तॄ to cross, Uṇādi affix अनि.
तरणिपेटक: तरणिपेटक m. (-कः) An oval bowl or bason of wood, for baling a boat. E. तरणि, and पेटक a basket, the boat's basket.
तरण्ड: तरण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा or ण्डी-ण्डं) A boat, a vessel. mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) 1 A raft or float, made of bambus, &c. tied together, and sometimes floated upon jars or hollow gourds inverted. 2 The float of a fishing line. 3 An oar. m. (-ण्डः) A country. E. तॄ to cross, अण्डन् aff.
तरण्डपादा: तरण्डपादा f. (-दा) A boat. E. तरण्ड an oar, and पाद a foot, having oars for feet.
तरत्: तरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Crossing, passing over. n. (-रत् or रद्) 1 A float or raft. 2 A kind of duck. E. तॄ to cross, शतृ affix of the active participle.
तरत्सल: तरत्सल m. (-लः) Conflagration of chaff: see तृणाग्नि.
तरन्त: तरन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A fog. 2 A hard shower, a torrent of rain. 3 The ocean. f. (-न्ती) A boat. E. तॄ to cross, झच् aff.
तरम्बुज: तरम्बुज n. (-जं) A watermelon, (most probably borrowed from the Persian, تربز)
तरपण्य: तरपण्य n. (-ण्यं) Fare, freight. E. तर passing (a river), and पण्य price.
तरल: तरल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Trembling, tremulous. 2 Libidinous, lecherous, wanton. 3 Luminous, splendid. 4 Hollow. 5 Liquid, liquefied. m. (-लः) 1 The central gem of a necklace. 2 A necklace. 3 Bottom, depth, lower or under part. f. (-ला) 1 Rice gruel. 2 Wine, vinous or spirituous liquor. 3 A bee. E. तॄ to pass, to go or move, affix कल.
तरलता: तरलता f. (-ता) Tremulousness, unsteadiness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, तललत्वं.
तरललोचना: तरललोचना f. (-ना) A woman with rolling or tremulous eyes. E. तरल trembling, and लोचना an eye.
तरलायित: तरलायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Caused to tremble, agitated, undulating. m. (-तः) 1 A large wave or surf. 2 Fickleness. E. तरल used as a verb, क्त aff.
तरलित: तरलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, trembling, tremulous. E. तरल trembling, and इतच् aff.
तरवारि: तरवारि m. (-रिः) A sword, a scymitar. E. तर passing, वॄ to effect, इञ् affix; making its pass through the enemy, &c. also तरवारिक m. (-कः.)
तरस्: तरस् n. (-रः) 1 Speed, velocity. 2 Strength. 3 A bank. 4 A float, a raft. E. तॄ to go, to go quick, &c. असुन् aff.
तरस: तरस n. (-सं) Flesh. E. तरस् strength, affix अच्; in which there is strength.
तरस्थान: तरस्थान n. (-नं) A landing place, a wharf or stairs. E. तर passing, ferrying, and स्थान place.
तरस्वत्: तरस्वत् mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) 1 Quick, swift. 2 Valiant. E. तरस्, and वतुप् aff.
तरस्विन्: तरस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 1 Quick, swift. 2 Strong, valiant. m. (-स्वी) 1 A courier, an express, a runner. 2 A hero. 3 The bird of VIṢṆU. 4 Air, wind. E. तरस् speed, &c. विनि aff.
तरान्धु: तरान्धु m. (-न्धुः) A large flat bottomed boat. E. तर crossing, अन्धु water; perhaps a various reading of the next.
तरालु: तरालु m. (-लुः) A flat bottomed boat. E. तर passing over, आलुच् affix: see the preceding.
तरि: तरि f. (-रिः) 1 A boat. 2 A clothes basket. 3 The end of a cloth. E. तॄ to pass, Uṇādi affix इन्; also with ङीष् affix तरी see तर, &c.
तरिक: तरिक n. (-कं) A raft, a float. m. (-कः) A ferry-man. f. (-का) A boat. E. तरि a boat, कन् aff.
तरिकिन्: तरिकिन् m. (-की) A ferry-man. E. तरिक a raft, इनि aff.
तरित: तरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Carried over or across. f. (-ता) 1 The fore finger. 2 Garlic, or perhaps hemp: see गृञ्जन. E. त to cross, इनि aff.
तरिन्: तरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-णि) Who or what crosses. f. (-णी) A boat. E. तृ to go, in the causal, affix क्त.
तरितृ: तरितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) What crosses, passes or carries over. f. (-त्री) A boat, a raft. E. तृ to cross, तृच् aff.
तरिरथ: तरिरथ m. (-थः) An oar, a paddle. E. तरि a boat, and रथ a car.
तरीष: तरीष m. (-षः) 1 The ocean. 2 Heaven or paradise. 3 Decorating, ornamenting. 4 A raft, a float. 5 Practice, business, profession. f. (-षी) 1 The daughter of INDRA. E. तॄ to cross or cause to cross, Uṇādi affix ईषन्; in some of its senses this word and तबिष seem to be confounded: see तबिष and ताविष.
तरु: तरु m. (-रुः) A tree. E. तॄ to proceed, Uṇādi affix उ; what goes or grows; or from what flowers and fruits arise, &c.
तरुकूणि: तरुकूणि m. (-णिः) A sort of bird. E. तरु a tree, and कूण to contract, affix कि; nestling in the tree.
तरुज: तरुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Borne, produced by a tree, (as a flower, fruit, &c.) E. तरु, and ज born.
तरुजीवन: तरुजीवन n. (-नं) The root of a tree. E. तरु a tree, and जीवन living.
तरुण: तरुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Young, juvenile. 2 New, fresh, novel. m. (-णः) 3 A young man, one of the virile age. 4 The castor oil plant. 5 Large cumin seed. f. (-णी) 1 A young woman from 16 to 30 years of age; generally however one about the first age. 2 The aloe tree, (A. perfoliata.) 3 A perfume, commonly Chira. 4 A flower, the Indian white rose, (Rosa standulifera.) n. (-णं) A kind of flower, that of the Achyranthes aspera? (कुजपुष्प.) E. तॄ to pass away, उनन् Uṇādi aff.
तरुणज्वर: तरुणज्वर m. (-रः) A fever that lasts a week. E. तरुण, and ज्वर fever.
तरुणदधि: तरुणदधि n. (-धि) Curds five days old. E. तरुण, and दधि curds.
तरुणास्थि: तरुणास्थि n. (-स्थि) Cartilage, gristle. E. तरुण, and अस्थि bone.
तरुणीगण: तरुणीगण m. (-णः) A number of young women. E. तरुणी, and गण a troop.
तरुणीजन: तरुणीजन m. (-नः) A young woman. E. तरुणी, and जन person.
तरुतल: तरुतल m. (-लः) The part under the branches of a tree, the ground about its root. E. तरु, and तल below.
तरुतूलिका: तरुतूलिका f. (-का) The flying fox. E. तरु a tree, and तूलिका scales, suspended like a balance from the branches of a tree; also read तरुदूलिका.
तरुनख: तरुनख m. (-खः) A thorn. E. तरु a tree, and नख a nail.
तरुपङ्क्ति: तरुपङ्क्ति f. (-क्तिः) A row of trees, an avenue. E. तरु, and पंक्ति a line.
तरुभुज्: तरुभुज् m. (-क्) A parasite plant. E. तरु, and भुज what enjoys.
तरुमृग: तरुमृग m. (-गः) A monkey, an ape. E. तरु a tree, and मृग a deer.
तरुराग: तरुराग m. (-गः) 1 A bud, a blossom. 2 A new sprout. E. तरु a tree, राग delight.
तरुविटप: तरुविटप m. (-पः) A branch or sprout. E. तरु, and विटप a shoot.
तरुराज: तरुराज m. (-जः) The palmyra tree. E. तरु, and राज king, chief.
तरुरुहा: तरुरुहा f. (-हा) A parasite plant. E. तरु, and रुह what mounts.
तरुरोहिणी: तरुरोहिणी f. (-णी) A parasite plant. E. तरु, and रोहिणी what ascends.
तरुशायिन्: तरुशायिन् m. (-यी) A bird. E. तरु a tree, and शीङ् to sleep, with णिनि aff.
तरुसार: तरुसार m. (-रः) Camphor. E. तरु a tree, and सार essence.
तरुस्थ: तरुस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Staying or being in a tree. f. (-स्था) A parasite plant. E. तरु, and स्थ what stays.
तरूट: तरूट m. (-टः) The root of the lotus.
तर्क: तर्क r. 10th cl. (तर्कयति) 1 To shine. 2 To speak. 3 To reason, to discuss. 4 To doubt or apprehend.

तर्क m. (-र्कः) 1 Doubt or disputation, discussion, reasoning. 2 Wish, desire. 3 Supplying an ellipsis. 4 Cause, motive. 5 The science of reasoning, logic. 6 (In Logic,) Reduction to absurdity, a conclusion opposed to or disproving the premises. E. तर्क to infer, to reason, &c. affix घञ्.
तर्कक: तर्कक m. (-कः) 1 A supplicant, a petitioner, an asker. 2 A logician. E. तर्क to reason, and affix वुन्.
तर्कयत्: तर्कयत् mfn. (-यत्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Expecting, anticipating. 2 Doubting. E. तर्क to doubt, शतृ aff.
तर्कविद्या: तर्कविद्या f. (-द्या) The science of reasoning or logic. E. तर्क as above, and विद्या knowledge.
तर्काभास: तर्काभास m. (-सः) Apparent reduction to absurdity, or seeming not real, incompatibility of the conclusion with the premises. E. तर्क, and आभास fallacy.
तर्कारी: तर्कारी f. (-री) A tree, (Aeschynomene sesban.) E. तर्क reasoning, ऋ to go or affect, affixes अण and ङीप्.
तर्कित: तर्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Doubted, apprehended. 2 Discussed. E. तर्क to doubt, क्त aff.
तर्किन्: तर्किन् m. (-की) A logician, a disputant, a follower of the Tarka Śāstra. E. तर्क as above, इनि aff.
तर्कु: तर्कु f. (-र्कुः) A spindle, an iron pin upon which the cotton is first drawn out; it also serves as the distaff, the cotton being next transferred from it to the wheel. E. कृत to cut, Uṇādi affix उ, and the radical letters transposed.
तर्कुट: तर्कुट n. (-टं) Drawing out the cotton upon the distaff or upon the wheel. f. (-टी) A spindle or a distaff: see तर्कु. E. कृत to cut, &c. उटच् affix, and the radical letters transposed.
तर्कुपिण्ड: तर्कुपिण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A ball of clay, &c. upon the lower end of the spindle to assist in giving it a rotatory motion. E. तर्कु as above, पिण्ड a lump.
तर्कुपीठी: तर्कुपीठी f. (-ठी) A ball at the lower end of a spindle: see the preceding. E. तर्कु a spindle, and पीठ a stool.
तर्कुलासक: तर्कुलासक m. (-कः) A concave shell or saucer in which the lower end of the spindle is placed, and whirled round. E. तर्कु a spindle, लस to go, ण्वुल् aff.
तर्कुशाण: तर्कुशाण m. (-णः) A small whetstone, for sharpening spindles, &c. E. तर्कु a spindle, and शाण a whetstone.
तर्क्षु: तर्क्षु m. (-र्क्षुः) A hyena. E. तर्ज to give pain, affix कु; also तरक्षु.
तर्ज: तर्ज r. 1st and 10th cls. (तर्जति-ते तर्जयति) To blame, to censure, to reprove.
तर्जन: तर्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Blaming, censuring. 2 Pointing at, in ridicule, or contempt. 3 Putting to shame, surpassing. 4 Wrath, anger. f. (-नी) The forefinger. E. तर्ज to abuse, to injure, affixes ल्युट् and ङीप्.
तर्ज्जन: तर्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Blaming, censuring. 2 Pointing at, in ridicule, or contempt. 3 Putting to shame, surpassing. 4 Wrath, anger. f. (-नी) The forefinger. E. तर्ज to abuse, to injure, affixes ल्युट् and ङीप्.
तर्जिक: तर्ज्जिक m. (-कः) The name of a country, perhaps to the north-west of India or Bokhara, &c. the country of the Tājiks: also तायिक.
तर्ज्जिक: तर्ज्जिक m. (-कः) The name of a country, perhaps to the north-west of India or Bokhara, &c. the country of the Tājiks: also तायिक.
तर्जित: तर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blamed, reviled. 2 Shamed, disgraced. E. तर्ज to blame, affix क्त.
तर्ज्जित: तर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blamed, reviled. 2 Shamed, disgraced. E. तर्ज to blame, affix क्त.
तर्ण: तर्ण m. (-र्णः) A calf. E. तॄ to go, ण affix; also with कन् added, तर्णक.
तर्णक: तर्णक m. (-कः) A calf: see the preceding.
तर्णि: तर्णि m. (-र्णिः) 1 A raft, a float. 2 The sun. E. तॄ to cross, affix णि.
तर्तरीक: तर्त्तरीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A passenger, one who passes or crosses. n. (-कं) A boat, a raft, a vessel. E. तॄ to cross over, ईकन् aff. and deriv. irr.
तर्त्तरीक: तर्त्तरीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A passenger, one who passes or crosses. n. (-कं) A boat, a raft, a vessel. E. तॄ to cross over, ईकन् aff. and deriv. irr.
तर्द: तर्द r. 1st cl. (तर्दति) To kill or hurt.
तर्दू: तर्दू m. (-र्दूः) A wooden ladle. E. तॄ to go, Uṇādi affix उ, and दूट् augment.
तर्पण: तर्पण n. (-णं) 1 Satisfaction given or received; either the act of pleasing, or the state of being pleased. 2 Satiety, fulness. 3 A religious rite, presenting water to the manes of the deceased or to the Pitṛs collectively; also to the gods either generally or individually. 4 Fuel used on sacrificial occasions. f. (-णी) A plant; also गुरुस्कन्ध. E. तृप to satisfy or be satisfied, affix ल्युट्.
तर्पणेच्छु: तर्पणेच्छु mfn. (-च्छुः-च्छुः-च्छु) Desirous of satisfaction, or of receiving after death the presentation of water called Tarpaṇa. m. (-च्छुः) A name of BHĪṢMA. E. तर्पण as above, इच्छु to wish, and उ aff.
तर्पित: तर्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pleased, satisfied. E. तृप to be pleased, क्त affix, with इट्.
तर्पिन्: तर्पिन् mfn. (-र्पी-र्पिणी-र्पि) 1 Giving pleasure or satisfaction. 2 Offering oblations to the manes, (who does so.) f. (-णी) A plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) E. तृप to give pleasure, इनि and ङीप् affs.
तर्ब: तर्ब r. 1st cl. (तर्बति) To go or move.
तर्बट: तर्ब्बट m. (-टः) A year. E. तर्ब्ब to go, अटन् aff.
तर्ब्बट: तर्ब्बट m. (-टः) A year. E. तर्ब्ब to go, अटन् aff.
तर्मन्: तर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The top or term of the sacrificial post. E. तॄ to pass up, and मनिन् aff.
तर्म्मन्: तर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The top or term of the sacrificial post. E. तॄ to pass up, and मनिन् aff.
तर्ष: तर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Thirst. 2 Wish, desire. 3 The ocean. 4 A raft or float. 5 The sun. E. तृष to thirst, affix अच्, or तॄ to pass over, and ष Uṇādi aff.
तर्षण: तर्षण n. (-णं) Thirst, thirsting: it is also used metaphorically. E. तृष to thirst, affix ल्युट्.
तर्षित: तर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thirsting, athirst, thirsty. 2 Desiring, wishing for. E. तृष to thirst, affix क्त.
तर्हि: तर्हि ind. Therefore. E. तद that, and र्हिल् aff.
तल: तल r. 1st and 10th cls. (तलति तालयति) 1 To be full or complete. 2 To fix, to found. 3 To establish.

तल n. (-लं) 1 Essential nature, (in composition especially, as महीतलं the earth itself, the very earth.) 2 Depth, bottom, lowness, inferiority of position, the place under or underneath. 3 A wood, a forest. 4 A hole, a pit, a chasm. 5 Cause, origin, motive, the root or seed of events. 6 Sole of the foot. 7 A slap with the hand. nf. (-लं-ला) A leathern fence worn by archers on the left arm. m. (-लः) 1 The palmyra tree. 2 The palm with extended fingers. 3 The hilt or handle of a sword, &c. 4 Pressing the strings of a lute with the left hand. 3 The stand or support of any thing, that which is under or below it. 6 The fore arm. 7 A span. E. तल to fix, affix अच्.
तलक: तलक n. (-कं) A large pond. E. तल a hole, a hollow, and कन् aff.
तलप्रहार: तलप्रहार m. (-रः) A slap or blow with the palm of the hand. E. तल the open palm, प्रहार striking.
तलवारण: तलवारण n. (-णं) A sword. E. तल, and वारण opposing.
तलसारक: तलसारक n. (-कं) 1 A martingale. 2 A vessel from which horses are fed. E. तल below, सृ to go, in the causal form, वुन् aff.
तलहृदय: तलहृदय n. (-यं) The centre of the sole of the foot. E. तल below, and हृदय heart.
तलाची: तलाची f. (-ची) A mat, one made of reeds or bamboos. E. तल below, अञ्च to go, क्विप् affix, fem. form.
तलातल: तलातल n. (-लं) One of the seven divisions of the infernal regions. E. तल below, reiterated, as downadown.
तलिका: तलिका f. (-का) A martingale. E. तल to fix, and वुन् aff.
तलित: तलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fixed, placed, having a bottom. n. (-तं) Fried meat. E. तल to be fixed or to satisfy, क्त aff.
तलिन: तलिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Separate, having spaces or interstices. 2 Clear, clean. 3 Small, little. 4 Delicate, thin, spare. 5 Below, situated under or underneath. n. (-नं) A bed, a couch or cot. E. तल to fix or be fixed, Uṇādi affix इनन्.
तलिम: तलिम n. (-मं) 1 Ground prepared for the site of a dwelling, &c. see कुट्टिम. 2 A bed, a couch or cot. 3 An awning. 4 A scymitar, a large sacrificial sword or knife. E. तल to fix, इमन् aff.
तलुन: तलुन m. (-नः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A youth. f. (-नी) A young woman. E. तॄ to pass, उनन् affix, and र changed to लः see तरुण.
तलेक्षण: तलेक्षण m. (-णः) A hog. E. तल down, and ईक्षण looking.
तलोदरी: तलोदरी f. (-री) A mistress or wife.
तलोदा: तलोदा f. (-दा) A river. E. तल steep, down, उद water.
तल्क: तल्क n. (-ल्कं) A wood, a forest. E. तल to fix, क Uṇādi aff.
तल्प: तल्प mn. (-ल्पः-ल्पं) 1 A bed. 2 An upper story, a room on the top of a house, a turret, a tower or keep. 3 A wife. E. तल to fix, Uṇādi affix प.
तल्पकीट: तल्पकीट m. (-टः) A bug. E. तल्प a bed, and कीट an insect.
तल्पज: तल्पज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Born of a wife, (as a son by an appointed substitute.) 2 Produced in or from a bed, &c. E. तल्प, and ज born.
तल्पन: तल्पन n. (-नं) An elephant's back. 2 The exterior muscles of the back. E. तल्प a nominal verb, to be as a bed, to be broad, &c. and ल्युट् aff.
तल्ल: तल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A reservoir, a large pond, a tank or Talao. f. (-ल्ला) 1 A young woman. 2 A boat. 3 The wife of VARUṆA. n. (-ल्लं) A pit, a hole. E. तल deep, depth, and ल to be or have, from ला with ड aff.
तल्लज: तल्लज m. (-जः) Excellence, happiness; also attributively, Excellent, happy: used in apposition as an epithet, the gender is not changed, as कुमारीतल्लजः an excellent maiden. E. तत् that, (that which is every thing,) and लज to attain, affix अच्.
तल्व: तल्व n. (-ल्वं) Scent arising from the rubbing of fragrant substances.
तवक: तवक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Thine. E. कन् added to तव the poss. case of त्वं.
तवराज: तवराज m. (-जः) A sort of sugar prepared from a species of Hedysarum.
तविष: तविष m. (-षः) 1 Heaven, paradise. 2 The ocean. f. (-षी) 1 A river. 2 The daughter of INDRA. 3 Strength, (in the dialect of the Vedas.) E. तव a Sautra root, टिषच् Uṇādi affix; also ताविष and तवीष.
तवीष: तवीष m. (-षः) 1 Heaven. 2 The ocean. 3 Gold. E. see the last.
तष्ट: तष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Pared, made thin. E. तक्ष to pare, affix क्त.
तष्टृ: तष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) 1 A carpenter. 2 A name of VIŚVAKARMA. 3 One of the twelve Ādityas or suns; also त्वष्टृ. E. तक्ष to pare, तृच् aff.
तस: तस (इर उ) इरतसु r. 4th cl. (तस्यति) To throw, to toss, to direct, to send. (इ) तसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (तंसति तंसयति or with अव prefixed अवतंसति अवतंसयति) To adorn, to dress or decorate.
तसर: तसर m. (-रः) A shuttle. E. तन to stretch, क्मरन् Uṇādi aff.
तस्कर: तस्कर m. (-रः) 1 A thief, a robber. 2 The ear. 3 A kind of potherb, (Medicago esculenta.) 3 A tree, (Vangueria spinosa:) see मदन. f. (-री) A passionate woman. E. तत् that, used depreciatingly, and कर who does, सुट् substituted for the final of तत्.
तस्करता: तस्करता f. (-ता) 1 Thievishness, thieving. 2 Hearing, catching by the ear. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, तस्करत्वं.
ताटङ्क: ताटङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) An ornament of the ear, a large sort of ear-ring: see ताडङ्क and तालपत्र.
ताटस्थ्य: ताटस्थ्य n. (-स्थ्यं) 1 Indifference, disregard, exemption from attachment or aversion. 2 Proximity. E. तटस्थ, and ष्यञ् aff.
ताड: ताड m. (-डः) 1 Beating, whipping, inflicting bodily chastisement. 2 Sound, noise. 3 A handful of grass, corn, &c. a sheaf. 4 A mountain. 5 A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.) f. (-डि or डी) A kind of palm, (Corypha talliera, Rox.) see ताली. E. तड to give pain, to beat, &c. affix घञ्.
ताडका: ताडका f. (-का) A female demon, killed by RĀMA.
ताडङ्क: ताडङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A kind of ear-ring: see तालपत्र. E. तड to shine, अङ्कन् affix; also ड being changed to ट, ताटङ्क.
ताडघ: ताडघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) Beating with a whip or with strokes of any kind. E. ताड, and घ who strikes.
ताडघात: ताडघात m. (-तः) An artificer who beats or hammers any thing. E. ताड, and घात a blow.
ताडन: ताडन n. (-नं) Beating, whipping, &c. f. (-नी) A whip. E. तड to beat, अनीयुट् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
ताडनीय: ताडनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be beaten, punishable. E. तड to beat, अनीयर् affix; also ताड्य and ताडयितव्य.
ताडपत्र: ताडपत्र n. (-त्रं) An ornament of the ear. E. ताड the Tāla tree, and पत्र a leaf, an earring resembling this: see तालपत्र.
ताडयितृ: ताडयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what beats or strikes. E. तड to beat, तृच् aff.
ताडयित्वा: ताडयित्वा ind. Having beaten. E. तड to beat, क्त्वा aff.
ताडित: ताडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Struck, beaten. E. तड to beat, क्त aff.
ताडुल: ताडुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Beating, who or what beats or strikes. E. तड to give pain, उलच् Uṇādi aff.
ताड्य: ताड्य mfn. (-ड्यः-ड्या-ड्यं) To be beaten or chastised, what may or ought to be punished, punishable. E. तड to beat, ण्यत् aff.
ताड्यमान: ताड्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being beaten or struck. m. (-नः) A musical instrument, which is struck, as a drum, &c. E. तड to beat or strike, शाणच् affix, यक् inserted.
ताण्डव: ताण्डव mn. (-वः-वं) 1 Dancing, especially with violent gesticulation, and particularly applied to the frantic dance of the god ŚIVA, and his votaries. 2 A sort of grass, (Saccharum procerum.) m. (-बः) In prosody, a tribrach or foot of three short syllables. E. तण्डु the name of the Muni, by whom the style of dancing was first taught, affix अण्; or तडि to beat, and अव aff.
ताण्डवतालिक: ताण्डवतालिक m. (-कः) A name of NANDI, one of ŚIVA'S principal attendants. E. ताण्डव ŚIVA'S dancing, and तालिक accompanier with music, from ताल tune or time, and ठक् aff.
ताण्डवप्रिय: ताण्डवप्रिय m. (-यः) A name of ŚIVA. E. ताण्डव dancing, and प्रिय fond of.
ताण्डि: ताण्डि f. (-ण्डिः) The science of dancing. E. तण्डु the teacher of this art, and इञ् aff.
तात: तात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Venerable, reverend, respectable. m. (-तः) 1 A father. 2 A term of affection addressed to any person, but especially to a junior or inferior, as हे तात oh! child, &c. E. तन to extend, (his race or fame,) क्त affix, and the vowel made long.
तातगु: तातगु mfn. (-गुः-गूः-गु) Paternal, relating or belonging to the father. m. (-गुः) A paternal uncle. E. तात a father, गु who goes or is, from गम to go, with डु aff.
तातजनयित्री: तातजनयित्री f. du. always (-त्र्यौ) Father and mother, parents. E. तात father, and जनयित्री mother.
ताततुल्य: ताततुल्य m. (-ल्यः) A paternal uncle, or the most respectable of the male relations. E. तात a father, and तुल्य like, equal to.
तातल: तातल m. (-लः) 1 A fatherly relative, one who may be considered as a father. 2 Sickness, disease. 3 An iron club or spike. 4 Cooking or maturing. 5 Heat, physical or morbid.
ताति: ताति m. (-तिः) A son. E. तन to spread, (the race,) ञि aff.
तात्कालिक: तात्कालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to any particular moment of time. E. तत्काल, and ठक् aff.
तात्पर्य: तात्पर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Object, purpose, intent, design. 2 Meaning, purport. 2 Explanation. E. तत्पर intent, यञ् aff.
तात्पर्य्य: तात्पर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Object, purpose, intent, design. 2 Meaning, purport. 2 Explanation. E. तत्पर intent, यञ् aff.
तात्पर्यार्थ: तात्पर्य्यार्थ m. (-र्थः) The meaning or purpose of a sentence. E. तात्पर्य्य purpose, and अर्थ meaning.
तात्पर्य्यार्थ: तात्पर्य्यार्थ m. (-र्थः) The meaning or purpose of a sentence. E. तात्पर्य्य purpose, and अर्थ meaning.
तादर्थ्य: तादर्थ्य n. (-र्थ्यं) 1 Sameness or precision of meaning. 2 Identity of object. E. तदर्थ, यञ् aff.
तादात्म्य: तादात्म्य n. (-त्म्यं) Identity, unity, sameness. E. तदात्म same, and यञ् aff.
तादृश्: तादृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Such like, like him or it, &c. E. तद् that, दृश to see, affix क्विन्; also with कञ् affix तादृश. mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) or with क्म affix, तादृक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं.)
तान: तान m. (-नः) A tune. n. (-नं) 1 Expanse, extension. 2 An object of sense. E. तन to extend, affix घञ्.
तानव: तानव n. (-वं) Thinness, spareness. E. तनु, and अण् aff.
तानूर: तानूर m. (-रः) A whirlpool. E. तन to spread, ऊरच् aff.
तान्त: तान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Wearied, fatigued, distressed. 2 Languid, languishing. 3 Faded, withered, blighted. E. तम to be distressed, affix क्त.
तान्तव: तान्तव m. (-वं) Spinning, weaving. E. तन्तु a thread, अण aff.
तान्त्र: तान्त्र mfn. (-न्त्रः-न्त्री-न्त्रं) 1 Stringed, having wires or strings, (as a musical instrument.) 2 Relating to the Tantras, &c. E. तन्त्र, and अण् aff.
तान्त्रिक: तान्त्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating to the Tāntras, taught by them, following them, &c. 2 Relating to a thread, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A scholar, a man completely versed in any science. 2 A follower of the doctrine taught by the Tantras. E. तन्त्र truth, &c. and ठक् aff.
ताप: ताप m. (-पः) 1 Heat, burning, (moral or physical.) 2 Pain, sorrow, distress. E. तप to burn or inflame, affix घञ् f. (-पी) A name of the Tapti or Surat river. 2 A name of the Yamunā or Jumna river. E. तप the sun, affix of descent इण्.
तापक: तापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Burning, inflaming, heating. m. (-कः) Fever, morbid heat. E. तप to burn, ण्वुल् aff.
तापत्य: तापत्य m. (-त्यः) ARJUNA. E. तपती, and यञ् affix of descent.
तापन: तापन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) What heats or inflames. m. (-नः) 1 The sun. 2 One of KĀMA'S arrows, the inflamer. 3 Sun-shine. 4 Heating, inflaming. E. तप to heat, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
तापनीय: तापनीय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Golden, made of gold. E. तपनीय, and अण् aff.
तापस: तापस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Performing penance, a practiser of devout austerities, a devotee, an ascetic. m. (-सः) A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea). n. (-सं) The leaf of the Laurus cassia. E. तपस penance, affix अण्.
तापसक: तापसक m. (-कः) A contemptible devotee, one not long engaged in austerities. E. तापस, and कन् depreciative aff.
तापसतरु: तापसतरु m. (-रुः) A tree, commonly Ingua or Jiyaputa, (Nagelia putranjiva.) E. तापस an ascetic, and तरु a tree; also similar compounds, as तापसद्रुम, तापसवृक्ष, &c.
तापसप्रिय: तापसप्रिय m. (-यः) A tree, (Chironjia sapida:) see पियाल. f. (-या) A grape. E. तापस an ascetic, प्रिय beloved by.
तापहर: तापहर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Cooling, removing heat. 2 Consoling, alleviating distress. f. (-री) A dish, a sort of soup, of pulse and grain, first fried with ghee and turmeric, and afterwards boiled with salt and sugar. E. ताप, and हर what removes.
तापिच्छ: तापिच्छ m. (-च्छः) A tree bearing dark blossoms, the Tamāla: see the next.
तापिञ्छ: तापिञ्छ m. (-ञ्छः) The Tamāla tree, (Xanthocymus pictorius.) E. तापिन् a person heated, and छद what covers or shelters, ड affix, deriv. irr.; also the final being dropped तापिच्छ, and with जि to conquer or remove तातिञ्ज.
तापिञ्ज: तापिञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) The Tamāla tree. n. (-ञ्जं) Sulphuret of iron: see the preceding.
तापित: तापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Inflamed. 2 Distressed, pained. E. तप to inflame, affix क्त.
तापिन्: तापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Oppressed by heat, morbid, moral or physical; any thing heated or glowing. m. (-पी) One of the deified saints of the Bauddhas. E. तप to heat, affix णिनि.
ताप्य: ताप्य mn. (-प्यः-प्यं) A mineral substance, sulphuret of iron. E. तापी the river, and यत् affix; said to be procured from the Tāpi river; also with कन् added ताप्यकं.
ताम: ताम m. (-मः) 1 An object of terror. 2 Fault, defect, vice. 3 Anxiety, distress. 4 Desire. E. तम to be distressed, affix घञ्.
तामर: तामर n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 Ghee or oiled butter. E. ताम desire, and र from रा to get or have; desirable for drinking, &c.
तामरस: तामरस n. (-सं) 1 A lotus, (Nymphæa nelumbo.) 2 Copper. 3 Gold. 4 A species of the Jagatī metre. E. तामर water, सम to abide, and ड affix; or ताम desire, and रस here implying object.
तामलकी: तामलकी f. (-की) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta:) see भूम्यामलकी. E. तम to desire, to be as it were, or resemble, आमलकी the Āmalaki.
तामलिप्त: तामलिप्त nf. (-प्तं-प्ती) A district in the south of Bengal, commonly Tumlook. E. ताम distress, trouble, and लिप्त smeared, affected.
तामस: तामस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) 1 Affected by or appertaining to the third quality, that of darkness or vice: belonging to it, as a Purāṇa, a system of philosophy, a ceremonial rite, &c. 2 Dark, of or belonging to darkness. m. (-सः) 1 A snake. 2 An incendiary, a malignant and mischievous man, a villain. 3 An owl. 4 The fourth Menu. f. (-सी) 1 A dark night. 2 A name of the goddess DURGĀ. n. (-सं) The quality of darkness. E. तमस् the quality of darkness, &c. affix अण्.
तामसिक: तामसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Of or belonging to the quality of darkness, derived from it, teaching lessons so characterised, &c. 2 Of or belonging to physical darkness. E. तसस्, and ठञ् aff.
तामिस्र: तामिस्र n. (-स्रं) 1 Great darkness. 2 A hell, that of deep gloom. m. (-स्रः) Indignation at being disappointed or slighted. E. तमिस्र, and अण् added.
ताम्बूल: ताम्बूल nf. (-लं-ली) 1 Areca, (Areca faufel or catechu.) 2 Betel, (Piper betel,) or its pungent leaf, which together with the areca nut and catechu, and sometimes caustic lime and spices, is eaten very generally by the natives of the east. n. (-लं) The areca nut. m. (-लः) Śaṇa, a plant, (Crotolaria juncea.) E. तम to desire, affix उलच्, and वुक्र् augment, the radical vowel made long.
ताम्बूलकरङ्क: ताम्बूलकरङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The Pān-dān or betel-box. E. ताम्बूल as above, and करङ्क a hollowed cocoanut, &c. which the Panbox usually resembles.
ताम्बूलद: ताम्बूलद m. (-दः) The betel bearer; kings and great men being attended by an officer of this description. E. ताम्बूल betel, and द who gives.
ताम्बूलपेटिका: ताम्बूलपेटिका f. (-का) A betel box. E. ताम्बूल, and पेटिका a casket.
ताम्बूलराग: ताम्बूलराग m. (-गः) A kind of pulse, (Ervum lens.) E. ताम्बूल betel, and राग colour.
ताम्बूलवल्ली: ताम्बूलवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A small plant bearing a pungent leaf, which with the areca nut, a small quantity of caustic lime (or Chunam) and catechu, and occasionally cloves, cardamoms, &c. form the Pan or betel of the Asiatic, (Piper betel.) E. ताम्बूल the same, and वल्ली foot-stalk; also with कन् added ताम्बूलवल्लिका.
ताम्बूलवाहक: ताम्बूलवाहक m. (-कः) A betel bearer, a servant attached to men of rank to prepare the pān, and carry the betel box. E. ताम्बूल, and वाहक who carries; also ताम्बूलवाहिन् m. (-ही).
ताम्बूलिक: ताम्बूलिक mf. (-कः-की) A seller of betel. E. ताम्बूल, and ठक् aff.
ताम्बूलिन्: ताम्बूलिन् mf. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Relating or belonging to a Pān, having one, giving one, &c. m. (-ली) The Pān bearer, a servant who prepares and furnishes the Pān. E. ताम्बूल as above, इनि aff.
ताम्यत्: ताम्यत् mfn. (-म्यन्-म्यती-भ्यत्) Distressing, afflicting, annoying. E. तम to distress, शतृ aff.
ताम्र: ताम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्री-म्रं) Of a coppery red colour. n. (-म्रं) 1 Copper. 2 A kind of sandal, represented as of a dark red colour, and smelling like a lotus. 3 A dark or coppery red. m. (-म्रः) A leprosy with large red spots. f. (-म्री) A copper or metallic cup of prescribed capacity, and perforated by a small hole at the bottom, answering the purpose of an hour glass: it is put into a vessel of water, the water gradually filling it, and the cup sinking, marks the time that has elapsed. E. तम to desire, Uṇādi affix रक, and the vowel made long; or ताम्र copper, अण् and ङीष् affixes, implying analogy or derivation.
ताम्रक: ताम्रक n. (-कं) Copper. E. ताम्र as above, and कन् pleonastic aff.
ताम्रकर्णी: ताम्रकर्णी f. (-र्णी) A name of the female elephant of the west. E. ताम्र coppery, and कर्ण ear.
ताम्रकार: ताम्रकार m. (-रः) A brazier, a copper-smith. E. ताम्र copper, and कार worker.
ताम्रकिलि: ताम्रकिलि m. (-लिः) A small worm of a red colour. E. ताम्र red, and किलि a worm.
ताम्रकुट: ताम्रकुट m. (कः) A brazier or copper smith. E. ताम्र copper, कुट to cut, क्वुन् aff.
ताम्रकुट्टक: ताम्रकुट्टक m. (-कः) Tobacco. E. ताम्र, and कुट्ट a point: the word is imitative of the foreign original.
ताम्रकृमि: ताम्रकृमि m. (-मिः) The lady-bird, (Coccinella.) E. ताम्र red, and कृमि a worm.
ताम्रगर्भ: ताम्रगर्भ n. (-र्भं) Blue vitriol or sulphate of copper. E. ताम्र copper, and गर्भ womb or source.
ताम्रचूड: ताम्रचूड m. (-डः) A cock. E. ताम्र, and चूडा a crest.
ताम्रतनु: ताम्रतनु mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु) Having a ruddy or fair complexion, copper-coloured. E. ताम्र, and तनु body.
ताम्रपट्ट: ताम्रपट्ट n. (-ट्टं) A copper plate, such as Hindu grants of land, &c. are frequently inscribed on. E. ताम्र copper, and पट्ट a cloth.
ताम्रपर्णी: ताम्रपर्णी f. (-र्णी) 1 A large pond or lake. 2 The name of a river in the peninsula, and of the district in its vicinity.
ताम्रपत्र: ताम्रपत्र n. (-त्रं) A plate of copper. m. (-त्रः) A potherb: see जीव. E. ताम्र, and पत्र a leaf.
ताम्रपाकिन्: ताम्रपाकिन् m. (-की) A tree: see गर्द्दभाण्ड. E. ताम्र red, and पाकिन् ripening, the fruit being of this colour.
ताम्रपुष्प: ताम्रपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 A kind of ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.) 2 A plant, (Kæmpferia rotunda.) f. (-ष्पा) Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens). f. (-ष्पी) 1 Lythrum fruticosum: see धातृपुष्पिका. 2 Trumpet flower. 3 Red Tëori: see त्रिकृत्. E. ताम्र coppery red, and पुष्प a flower, bearing red blossoms.
ताम्रफल: ताम्रफल m. (-लः) A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.) E. ताम्र copper, and फल fruit.
ताम्रफलक: ताम्रफलक n. (-कं) A copper plate. E. ताम्र, and फलक a plank or board.
ताम्रमुख: ताम्रमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Copper-coloured, fair-complexioned. m. (-खः) A European. E. ताम्र, and मुख face.
ताम्रमूला: ताम्रमूला f. (-ला) A plant: see ग्राहिणी. E. ताम्र copper, and मूल root.
ताम्रमृग: ताम्रमृग m. (-गः) The red deer. E. ताम्र, and मृग a deer.
ताम्रवर्ण: ताम्रवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Red, copper-coloured. f. (-र्णी) The blossom of sesamum. E. ताम्र, and वर्ण colour.
ताम्रवल्ली: ताम्रवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) 1 Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) 2 A medicinal plant used as an emollient in affections of the mouth and fauces; also called तमाली, ताली, सूक्ष्मवल्ली, &c. E. ताम्र copper, and वल्ली pedicle.
ताम्रवीज: ताम्रवीज m. (-जः) A kind of vetch: see कुलत्य. E. ताम्र copper, and वीज the seed.
ताम्रवृक्ष: ताम्रवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A sort of Sandal wood. E. ताम्र copper, and ष्टक्ष a tree.
ताम्रवृन्त: ताम्रवृन्त mf. (-न्तः-न्ता) A kind of vetch: see कुलत्य. E. ताम्र copper, or coppery, वृत्त foot-stalk.
ताम्रशिखिन्: ताम्रशिखिन् m. (-खी) A cock. E. ताम्र copper, शिखा a crest, and इनि affix: see ताम्रचूड.
ताम्रसार: ताम्रसार m. (-रः) A red kind of Sandal, (Pterospermum santolinum). E. ताम्र copper, and सार pith.
ताम्राकु: ताम्राकु m. (-कुः) One of the eighteen minor divisions of the known continent.
ताम्राक्ष: ताम्राक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Red-eyed. m. (-क्षः) The Koil or Kokila, the Indian cuckoo. E. ताम्र, and अक्षि an eye.
ताम्राभ: ताम्राभ n. (-भं) Red saunders. E. ताम्र copper, and आभ resembling.
ताम्रार्द्ध: ताम्रार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) Mixed or bell metal. E. ताम्र copper, and अर्द्ध part or half.
ताम्रिक: ताम्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of copper, made of copper, &c. m. (-कः) A brazier, a copper smith. E. ताम्र copper, and ठक् affix. f. (-का) A copper vessel for marking time. E. कन् added to ताम्री, q. v.
ताय: ताय (ऋ) तायृ r. 1st cl. (तायते) 1 To spread, to extend, to proceed in a continuous stream or line. 2 To cherish or protect.
तायिक: तायिक m. (-कः) A country; or plu. m. (-काः) Its inhabitants. E. ताय to cherish, इकन् aff.
तार: तार mfn. adj. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 High, as a note in music. 2 Radiant, shining, radiating. 3 Clean, clear. 4 Good, excellent, well flavoured, &c. m. (-रः) 1 A high note or tone in music. 2 Elegance of a pearl. 3 A clear or beautiful pearl. 4 Crossing, passing over, &c. 5 A wire, a chord. 6 The mystic monosyllable. Om. 7 A mystical monosyllable in the Tantras. 8 The name of a monkey chief, the son of BĀLĪ. n. (-रं) 1 Silver. 2 A pearl. mfn. subst. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 The pupil of the eye. 2 A star in general, a planet, an asterism, &c. f. (-रा) A female deity peculiar to the Bauddha sect. 2 The wife of VṚHASPATI. 3 The wife of the monkey king SUGRĪVA. 4 A name of the goddess DURGĀ. E. तॄ to pass or proceed; also in the causal, to cause to pass, and अच् or घञ् aff.
तारक: तारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 A protector, a preserver. 2 One who causes or enables to pass or go over. n. (-कं) 1 The eye. 2 A Mantra, a formula addressed to Rāma, as Rāmāya namaḥ, nf. (-कं-का) 1 The pupil of the eye. 2 A star. mn. (-कः-कं) A float or raft. m. (-कः) A pilot, a helmsman or steersman. 2 The name of a demon or evil spirit destroyed by KĀRTTIKEYA. E. तॄ to pass or cause to pass, and ण्वुल् affix; or कन added to the preceding.
तारकजित्: तारकजित् m. (-जित्) A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. तारक a demon, and जित् conqueror: also similar names, as तारकारि, तारकहन्, तारकरिपु, &c.
तारकारि: तारकारि m. (-रिः) The deity KĀRTTIKEYA. E. तारक, and अरि a foe: see the preceding.
तारकित: तारकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Starry. E. तारक a star, इतच् aff.
तारकिन्: तारकिन् mfn. (-की-किणी-कि) Starry. f. (-णी) Night. E. तारक, and इनि aff.
तारण: तारण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Who or what causes or enables to cross. m. (-णः) A raft, a float. n. (-णं) Carrying or conveying across. E. तॄ to cross, affix ल्युट्.
तारणि: तारणि f. (-णिः) A boat. E. तॄ to pass over, अनि aff.
तारतम्य: तारतम्य n. (-म्यं) 1 More or less, the state or condition. 2 Dependance of larger numbers on smaller in a progressive series. E. तर, and तम affixes of the comparative and superlative degrees, and ष्यञ् aff.
तारनाद: तारनाद m. (-दः) A loud sound or noise. E. तार, and नाद sound.
तारल: तारल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Libidinous, dissipated, a lecher. E. तरल unsteady, affix अण्.
तारविमला: तारविमला f. (-ला) A sort of mineral said to be of the colour of silver. E. तार a star, and विमल pure, clean.
तारशुद्धिकर: तारशुद्धिकर n. (-रं) Lead. E. तार silver, शुद्धिकर what refines.
ताराधिपति: ताराधिपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. तारा a star, and अधिपति a ruler.
तारापथ: तारापथ m. (-थः) The atmosphere, the firmament, heaven or sky. E. तारा a star, and पथ for पथिन् a path.
तारापीड: तारापीड m. (-डः) The moon. E. तार a star, and आपीड a chaplet.
ताराभूषा: ताराभूषा f. (-षा) Night. E. तारा, and भूषा ornament.
ताराभ्र: ताराभ्र m. (-भ्रः) Camphor. E. तारा, and अभ्र talc.
तारामण्डल: तारामण्डल m. (-लः) 1 A large splendid temple. 2 The region of the stars. E. तारा a star, and मण्डल a region; shining with gold and jewels as with stars.
तारारि: तारारि m. (-रिः) A pyritic ore of iron: see विट्माक्षिक. E. तारा the pupil of the eye, and अरि hostile.
तारिक: तारिक n. (-कं) Fare, freight, toll. f. (-का) 1 A star; also तारका. 2 The juice of the palmyra tree, especially when become a spirit by spontaneous fermentation. E. तर fare, ठक् affix, or तारक fem. form, or ताल and कन् added, ल changed to र.
तारिन्: तारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Enabling or causing to cross or get over. f. (-णी) 1 A goddess peculiar to the Jainas or Bauddhas. 2 A name of DURGĀ. E. तॄ to cause to proceed, (life, fortune, &c.) and ङीष् aff.
तारीष: तारीष m. (-षः) 1 Svarga or paradise. 2 The ocean. 3 Gold. f. (-षी) The daughter of INDRA. E. तृ to cross, ईषन् affix, fem. affix ङीष्: see तरीष and तविष.
तारुण्य: तारुण्य n. (-ण्यं) Youth. E. तरुण young, ष्यञ् aff.
तारेय: तारेय m. (-यः) The son of BĀLĪ, the monkey. E. तारा the wife of BALI, and ढक् aff.
तार्कव: तार्क्कव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Spun, made with or belonging to a spindle. E. तर्कु, and अण् aff.
तार्क्कव: तार्क्कव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Spun, made with or belonging to a spindle. E. तर्कु, and अण् aff.
तार्किक: तार्क्किक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or attached to the science of reasoning or logic. m. (-कः) A philosopher, a sophist, a follower of either of the six schools of Hindu philosophy. E. तर्क doubt, disputation, affix ठक्.
तार्क्किक: तार्क्किक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or attached to the science of reasoning or logic. m. (-कः) A philosopher, a sophist, a follower of either of the six schools of Hindu philosophy. E. तर्क doubt, disputation, affix ठक्.
तार्क्ष: तार्क्ष m. (-र्क्षः) A name of KAŚYAPA.
तार्क्ष्य: तार्क्ष्य m. (-र्क्ष्यः) 1 A horse. 2 A name of GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. 3 A name of ARUṆA, or the dawn personified, considered as the elder brother of GARUḌA. 4 A car, a chariot. 5 A snake. 6 Gold. 7 A tree, the Sal, (Shorea robusta.) n. (-र्क्ष्यं) A sort of collyrium. f. (-र्क्ष्यी) A wild creeper. E. तृक्ष to go, घञ् affix तार्क्ष and यत् added; again, तृक्ष or तार्क्षं considered as a name of KAŚYAPA the father of ARUṆA, &c. ष्यञ् or अण् aff.
तार्क्ष्यध्वज: तार्क्ष्यध्वज m. (-जः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. तार्क्ष्य GARUḌA, and ध्वज emblem or symbol.
तार्क्ष्यनायक: तार्क्ष्यनायक m. (-कः) GARUḌA. E. तार्क्ष्य, and नायक leader.
तार्क्ष्यशैल: तार्क्ष्यशैल n. (-लं) A substance prepared from the calx of brass, or from the Amomum anthorrhiza, and used as a medical application to the eyes; see रसाञ्जन. E. तार्क्ष्य a collyrium, and शैल derived from शिला a rock or stone.
तार्य: तार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be crossed or carried across, to be ferried over. n. (-र्य्यं) Toll, fare, freight. E. तृ to cross, ण्यत् aff.
तार्य्य: तार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be crossed or carried across, to be ferried over. n. (-र्य्यं) Toll, fare, freight. E. तृ to cross, ण्यत् aff.
ताल: ताल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Made of the palm wood. m. (-लः) 1 Beating time in music, musical time or measure. 2 A short span, one measured by the thumb and middle finger. 3 Slapping or clapping the hands together, or against the arms, &c. 4 The open hand with the fingers extended, the palm. 5 A musical instrument of bell metal or brass, (a sort of cymbal,) played with a stick. 6 The hilt of a sword or sacrificial knife, &c. 7 The palmyra tree or fan palm, (Borassus flabelliformis.) 8 A lock, a bolt. 9 In prosody, a trochee. n. (-लं) 1 The throne of DURGĀ. 2 Yellow orpiment: see हरिताल. 3 The fruit of the palm tree. f. (-ली) 1 A sort of key or pin. 2 A species of the mountain palm, (Corypha taliera, Rox.) 3 A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta:) see झटा and अमला. 4 A fragrant earth: see तुवरिका. 5 A plant, (Curculigo orchioides.) 6 The spirituous juice of the palm, the common Toddy. E. तल to fix or तन to spread, affix घञ्; or in the causal form, with अच् affix, fem. affix ङीष्, न changed to ल; otherwise, तड to beat, to overcome, (disease, &c.) अच् and ङीष् affixes, and ड changed to ल; the adjective is derived from the substantive by adding अण्.
तालक: तालक n. (-कं) 1 A bolt, a latch, a kind of lock for fastening a door with. 2 Yellow orpiment. 3 A fragrant earth. E. कन् added to the preceding.
तालकाभ: तालकाभ adj. mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Green. m. (-भः) Green, the colour. E. तालक yellow orpiment, and आभ what resembles.
तालकी: तालकी f. (-की) Toddy, or the fermented exudation of the palm trees. E. ताल the palmyra, कन् aff.
तालजटा: तालजटा f. (-टा) The fibres of the palm tree under the outer bark. E. ताल, and जटा matted hair.
तालध्वज: तालध्वज m. (-जः) A name of BALARĀMA. f. (-जा) The name of a city. E. ताल the palm, and ध्वज a banner.
तालपत्र: तालपत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A hollow cylinder of gold with or without a ring attached to it, thrust through the lobe of the ear, and worn as an ornament. 2 The palm leaf. E. ताल the palmyra, and पत्र a leaf, pieces of the leaf of this tree being rolled up and used occasionally for the purpose or as a substitute. f. (-त्री) A plant: see मूषिकपर्णी. E. as above; the leaves resembling those of the palm tree, or the palm of the hand.
तालपर्ण: तालपर्ण nf. (-र्णं-र्णी) 1 A kind of vegetable perfume: see मुरा. f. (-र्णी) A sort of anise, (Anethum pammorium, Rox.) E. ताल the palm, and पर्ण a leaf, palm-leaved.
तालपुष्पक: तालपुष्पक n. (-कं) A medicinal application to the eyes. E. ताल the palmyra, पुष्प a flower, and कन् affix; perhaps prepared from the blossoms of the palmyra.
तालप्रलम्व: तालप्रलम्व n. (-म्वं) The fibres that grow on the cocoanut and other palms, under the outer rind, and from which Coir, a sort of cordage, is prepared. E. ताल, and प्रलम्व what depends.
तालभृत्: तालभृत् m. (-भृत्) A name of BALARĀMA. E. तास्व the palm, and भृत् who retains, (as his banner or symbol:) see तालध्वज, &c.
तालमय: तालमय mn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of the palm, &c. E. ताल, and मयट् aff.
तालमूली: तालमूली f. (-ली) A plant, (Curculigo orchioides.) E. ताल the palm, and मूल a root, having a similar root; also with कन् added तालमूलिका f. (-का).
तालयन्त्र: तालयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) 1 A lock, a lock and key. 2 A small pair of pincers. E. ताल, and यन्त्र instrument.
ताललक्ष्मन्: ताललक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) A name of BALARĀMA. E. ताल, and लक्ष्मन् a mark or sign: see तालध्वज.
तालवृन्त: तालवृन्त m. (-न्तः) A fan. E. ताल the palm of the hand, and वृन्त a root-stalk; expanding from the hand like a leaf from its stem; also with कन् added तालवृन्तक.
तालवृन्तक: तालवृन्तक n. (-कं) A fan, a Pankha: see the preceding.
तालवेचनक: तालवेचनक m. (-कः) A dancer, an actor. E. ताल musical tone, विच to observe, ल्यु affix, तालवेचन and कन् pleonasm added; also read तालरेचनक.
तालाख्या: तालाख्या f. (-ख्या) A perfume: see मुरा. E. ताल, the palmyra, and आख्या a name.
