तालाङ्क: तालाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 A name of BALARĀMA. 2 A saw. 3 A book. 4 A name of ŚIVA. 5 A man marked with every fortunate spot or sign, &c. 6 A sort of vegetable. E. ताल the tree, and अङ्क mark or emblem.
तालावचर: तालावचर m. (-रः) A dancer, an actor. E. ताल musical time, अवचर to follow or perform, to affix अच्.
तालि: तालि f. (-लिः) A kind of palm, (Corypha taliera:) see ताली.
तालिक: तालिक mf. (-कः-का) The open palm of the hand. m. (-कः) A tie, a seal, a string, &c. binding a letter or parcel of papers. f. (-का) A plant: see तालमूली. E. ताल as above, and कन् affix.
तालित: तालित n. (-तं) 1 Any musical instrument. 2 Dyed or coloured cloth. 3 A string, a tie. E. ताल musical time, &c. इतच् aff.
तालिश: तालिश m. (-शः) A mountain. E. ताल to be fixed, इश Uṇādi affix, the radical vowel made long.
तालीश: तालीश n. (शं) A tree, commonly Tālīśa or its leaf. E. ताल the corypha, ईश what resembles.
तालीशपत्र: तालीशपत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) 2 A tree, Tāliśa or its leaf, which is used in medicine. E. तालीश as above, and पत्र a leaf.
तालु: तालु n. (-लु) The palate. E. तॄ to pass, to go, Uṇādi affix, ञुण्; by which words, &c. proceed.
तालुका: तालुका f. (-का) The palate. E. तालु, and कन् added.
तालुजिह्व: तालुजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) 1 The uvula. 2 A crocodile. E. तालु the palate, and जिह्वा the tongue.
तालुपुप्पुट: तालुपुप्पुट m. (-टः) An indolent swelling of the palate.
तालूर: तालूर m. (-रः) A whirlpool, an eddy. E. तल to be deep, उरन् affix; also read तालुर.
तावक: तावक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Thine. E. तवक, and अण् added.
तावकीन: तावकीन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Thine. E. तवक for तव thine, and खञ् aff.
तावत्: तावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 So many, as many, as much. 2 All. ind. So much, so far, so many, unto, until, the correlative to यावत्. E. तत् that, then, and डावत् affix: see यावत्.
तावतिक: तावतिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Of so much, worth so much, &c. see the next.
तावत्क: तावत्क mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं) Of so much, bought for so much, &c. E. कन् added to तावत्; also with इट् inserted तावतिक.
तावत्काल: तावत्काल adv. n. (-लं) For so long a period, for such a time. E. तावत्, and काल time.
तावद्वयस: तावद्वयस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Measuring so much. E. तावत्, and द्धयसच् aff.
तावन्मात्र: तावन्मात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) So much. E. तावत्, and मात्रच् aff.
ताविष: ताविष m. (-षः) 1 Svarga or paradise. 2 The ocean. f. (-षी) The daughter of INDRA. 2 A river. 3 The earth. E. तव a Sautra root, Uṇādi affix टिषच्; also read तविष, तवीष, &c.
तास्कर्य: तास्कर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Theft, robbery. E. तस्कर, and यञ् aff.
तास्कर्य्य: तास्कर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Theft, robbery. E. तस्कर, and यञ् aff.
तिक: तिक r. 1st cl. (ऋ) तिकृ (तेकते) To go or move. r. 5th cl. (तिक्नोति) 1 To go. 2 To assail, to assault. 3 To seek to injure or kill: see तिग.
तिक्त: तिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Bitter. 2 Fragrant. m. (-क्तः) 1 A bitter taste, bitterness. 2 Fragrance, perfume. 3 A medicinal plant, (Echites antidysenterica.) 4 A tree, (Capparis trifoliata:) see वरुण. f. (-क्ता) Katuki, a medicinal plant. n. (-क्तं) A medicinal plant, (Mollugo pentaphylla.) E. तिज to sharpen, (the appetite,) affix क्त.
तिक्तक: तिक्तक m. (-कः) 1 A kind of gourd, (Trichosanthes diœca, Rox.) 2 A sort of gentian, (G. cherayta.) 3 A dark sort of the Khayar or Mimosa catechu. E. कन् added to तिक्त a bitter; alluding to the taste of these substances.
तिक्तगन्धा: तिक्तगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.) E. तिक्त fragrant, and गन्ध smell, fem. affix टाप्; also with कन् added, and the fem. form, तिक्तगन्धिका.
तिक्ततुम्बी: तिक्ततुम्बी f. (-म्बी) A bitter gourd. E. तिक्त, and तुम्बी a gourd.
तिक्तदुग्धा: तिक्तदुग्धा f. (-ग्धा) A medicinal kind of moon plant: see स्वर्णक्षीरी. E. तिक्त bitter, and दुग्ध milk.
तिक्तपत्र: तिक्तपत्र m. (-त्रः) A cucurbitaceous plant, (Momordica mixta.) E. तिक्त bitter, and पत्र a leaf.
तिक्तपर्वन्: तिक्तपर्व्वन् f. (-र्व्वां) 1 A potherb, (Hilancha repens.) 2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 3 Liquorice. E. तिक्त bitter, and पर्व्वन् a joint.
तिक्तपर्व्वन्: तिक्तपर्व्वन् f. (-र्व्वां) 1 A potherb, (Hilancha repens.) 2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 3 Liquorice. E. तिक्त bitter, and पर्व्वन् a joint.
तिक्तभद्रक: तिक्तभद्रक m. (-कः) A kind of cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.) E. तिक्त bitter, and भद्रक auspicious, useful in medicine.
तिक्तरोहिणिका: तिक्तरोहिणिका f. (-का) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी. E. तिक्त bitter, and रोहिणी the same plant, कन् added.
तिक्तवल्ली: तिक्तवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides.) E. तिक्त bitter, and वल्ली a stalk.
तिक्तशाक: तिक्तशाक m. (-कः) 1 A plant, (Capparis trifoliata:) see वरुण. 2 A kind of mimosa: see खदिर. E. तिक्त bitter, and शाक an esculent vegetable; also तिक्तशाकक.
तिक्तसार: तिक्तसार m. (-रः) A sort of mimosa, (M. catechu:) see खदिर E. तिक्त bitter, and सार pith.
तिक्तिका: तिक्तिका f. (-का) A bitter gourd. E. तिक्त, and कन् aff.
तिग: तिग r. 5th cl. (तिग्नोति) 1 To go or move. 2 To assail. 3 To seek to injure, to attempt to kill, &c. also तिक.
तिग्म: तिग्म mfn. (-ग्मः-ग्मा-ग्मं) 1 Hot. 2 Pungent, acrid. 3 Sharp, (as a weapon.) 4 Passionate, hasty. n. (-ग्मं) Heat; also the heat of spices, or pungency. E. तिज to sharpen, Uṇādi affix मक्.
तिग्मता: तिग्मता f. (-ता) 1 Sharpness. 2 Pungency. 3 Heat. 4 Passion, petulance. E. तल added to तिग्म; also with त्व, तिग्मत्वं.
तिग्मरुच्: तिग्मरुच् mfn. (-रुक्) 1 Bright, shining. 2 Hot. m. (रुक्) The sun. E. तिग्म, and रुच् light.
तिग्मांशु: तिग्मांशु m. (-शुः) The sun. E. तिग्म hot, and अंश्रु a ray; also similar compounds, as तिग्मकर, तिग्मरश्मि.
तिघ: तिघ r. 5th cl. (तिघ्नोति) To strike, to hurt or kill.
तिङ्गुद: तिङ्गुद m. (-दः) The name of a plant: see इङ्गुद.
तिज: तिज r. 1st cl. (तितिक्षते) To bear, to endure, to suffer with patience. r. 1st and 10th cls. (तेजते तेजयति) 1 To whet, to sharpen. 2 To shine: see तेज.
तिजिल: तिजिल m. (लः) 1 The moon. 2 A Rākṣasa. E. तिज to shine, and इलच् Uṇādi aff.
तिण्टी: तिण्टी f. (-ण्टी) A plant, commonly Teori, (Convolvulus turpethum.)
तितउ: तितउ mn. (-उः-उ) A sieve, a cribble. E. तन to spread or scatter, (grain, &c.) डौ Uṇādi affix, and the radical reiterated.
तितिक्षा: तितिक्षा f. (-क्षा) Patience, resignation, sufferance, endurance. E. तिज to bear, अङ् and टाप् affix, and the root repeated.
तितिक्षित: तितिक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Patient, resigned. E. तिज to bear, affix इतच्, and the root reduplicate.
तितिक्षु: तितिक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Patient, resigned. E. तिज to bear, reduplicated, and उ aff.
तितिल: तितिल n. (-लं) 1 One of the seven Karaṇas, or astronomical periods so called. 2 A bowl or bucket. 3 A sort of sweetmeat made of sesamum, ground, and baked with sugar. E. तिल to go, affix क, and the radical reiterated: see तैतिल.
तितीर्षा: तितीर्षा f. (-र्षा) 1 Wish to cross. 2 Wish to be freed from life. E. तॄ to cross, desid, form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
तितीर्षु: तितीर्षु mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु) 1 Desirous of crossing. 2 Desirous of emancipation from existence. E. तॄ to cross, desid. form, affix उ.
तित्तिर: तित्तिर m. (रः) The francoline partridge: see the next.
तित्तिरि: तित्तिरि m. (-रिः) 1 The francoline partridge. 2 The name of a Muni, and one of the early teachers of the Taittiri or Black Yajur Veda. 3 The Yajur Veda, named after its teacher. E. तित्ति an imitative sound, रा to make, affix कि; also with क affix तित्तिर.
तिथ: तिथ m. (-थः) 1 Fire. 2 KĀMA or love. 3 Time. E. तिथ to inflame, Uṇādi affix थक्, and the radical final rejected.
तिथि: तिथि mf. (-थिः-थिः or -थी) A lunar day, (1/30)th of a whole lunation. E. अत to go, to proceed, affix इथिन् and the radical initial rejected; also ङीष् being added तिथी.
तिथिक्षय: तिथिक्षय m. (-यः) Day of new moon. E. तिथि, and क्षय destruction.
तिथिप्रणी: तिथिप्रणी m. (-णीः) The moon. E. तिथि a lunar day, प्र before णी to get or obtain, affix क्विप्.
तिनाशक: तिनाशक m. (-कः) A tree: see the next.
तिनिश: तिनिश m. (-शः) A tree, (Dalbergia ougeiniensis.) E. अति exceeding, निश to meditate, affix क and the initial of the prefix rejected, deriv. irr.
तिन्तिड: तिन्तिड mf. (-डः-डी) The tamarind tree, (Tamarindus Indica.) m. (-डः) 1 The name of a demon. 2 Acid seasoning, sour sauce. 3 An inauspicious period, the evil aspect of planets, &c. f. (-डी) Emblic myrobalan. E. तिम to be damp or moist, अच् affix, the root reduplicated, and ड substituted for the final म.
तिन्तिडिका: तिन्तिडिका f. (-का) The tamarind tree. E. कन् added to तिन्तिडी.
तिन्तिडीक: तिन्तिडीक subst. mfn. (-कः-का-कं) The tamarind tree. n. (-कं) 1 Acid seasoning. 2 The fruit of the tamarind. E. तिन्तिड as above, and ईकन् Uṇādi aff.
तिन्तिडीद्यूत: तिन्तिडीद्यूत n. (-तं) A kind of game, a sort of odd or even played with tamarind seeds. E. तिन्तिडी the tamarind, and द्यूत playing.
तिन्तिली: तिन्तिली f. (-ली) The tamarind tree. E. see तिन्तिड, ल being substituted for ड; also कन् being added in the usual form, तिन्तिलिका, or retaining the final तिन्तिलीका.
तिन्दु: तिन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A species of ebony, from the fruit of which a kind of resin is obtained, that is used in India as pitch for caulking vessels, &c. (Diospyros glutinosa.) E. तिम to be wet or moist, affix कु; also with कन् added, तिन्दुक.
तिन्दुक: तिन्दुक mf. (-कः-की) A sort of ebony, (Diospyros glutinosa.) f. (-की) The resinous fruit of this tree: see the preceding. Also with इ substituted for the final तिन्दुकि. n. (-कं) A Karṣa, the measure. E. तिन्दु, and कन् added.
तिन्दुल: तिन्दुल m. (-लः) A sort of ebony: see the preceding. E. लच् added to तिन्दु.
तिप: तिप (उ ऋ) उ तिपृ r. 1st cl. (तेपते) To sprinkle, to distil or drop, to ooze or leak.
तिम: तिम r. 4th cl. (तिम्यति) To be or become wet, damp, &c.
तिम m. (-मः) A fish: see the next.
तिमि: तिमि m. (-मिः) 1 A whale, or a fabulous fish of an enormous size, said to be one hundred Yojanas long. 2 The ocean. E. तम to distress, इन् affix, and इ substituted for the radical vowel; otherwise तिम to be wet or watery, affix कि, or with क affix तिम.
तिमिकोष: तिमिकोष m. (-षः) The ocean. E. तिमि a fish, as above, and कोष receptacle: also तिमिकोषक.
तिमिङ्गिल: तिमिङ्गिल m. (-लः) A large fabulous fish: see तिमि. E. तिमि the fish so called, and गिल who swallows, (from गॄ with क affix, र changed to ल) and मुम् augment.
तिमिङ्गिलगिल: तिमिङ्गिलगिल m. (-लः) A fabulous fish larger than either of the preceding: see तिमि and तिमिंगिल. E. तिमिङ्गिल the fish so called, and गिल who devours.
तिमित: तिमित mn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Wet, moist, moistened, damp. 2 Steady, fixed, unmoved, unshaken. E. तिम to be wet or damp, affix क्त.
तिमिर: तिमिर n. (-रं) 1 Darkness. 2 Gutta serena, total blindness from affection of the optic nerve. E. तिम to be damp, or तम to give pain, किरच् Uṇādi affix, in the latter case इत् is inserted.
तिमिररिपु: तिमिररिपु m. (-पुः) The sun. E. तिमिर darkness, and रिपु an enemy.
तिमिष: तिमिष n. (-षः) 1 A kind of pumpkin gourd: see ग्राम्यकर्क्कटी. 2 A watermelon. E. तम to desire or be desired, इषच् affix, इत् inserted.
तिरश्चीन: तिरश्चीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sideways, awry, irregular. E. तिय्यच् and ख aff.
तिरस्: तिरस् ind. 1 Indirectly, underhandedly, secretly, covertly. 5 Crookedly, awry. 6 A particle of abuse or depreciation. E. तॄ to go, असच् aff.
तिरस्करिणी: तिरस्करिणी f. (-णी) 1 An outer tent, a Kenāt, a wall or screen of cloth surrounding the principal tent. 2 A veil. 3 A curtain. E. तिरस् secret, and करिणी making; also with the antepen. vowel long, तिरस्कारिणी.
तिरस्कार: तिरस्कार m. (-रः) 1 Disrespect, abuse, reproach. 2 Disappearance, concealment. E. तिरस् disrespect, and कार making.
तिरस्कृत: तिरस्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Reviled, abused, reproached, censured. 2 Veiled, hidden. 3 Vanished, disappeared. E. तिरस्, and कृत made.
तिरस्क्रिया: तिरस्क्रिया f. (-या) 1 Disrespect, contempt, reproach. 2 Disappearance, concealment. E. तिरस् disrespect, and क्रिया action.
तिरिट: तिरिट m. (-टः) The joint of the sugar cane.
तिरिम: तिरिम m. (-मः) A kind of rice.
तिरिय: तिरिय m. (-यः) A sort of rice.
तिरीट: तिरीट m. (-टः) Pale Lodh, a kind of tree: see लोध्र. n. (-टं) A diadem, a tiara. E. तॄ to pass, कीटन् Uṇādi aff.
तिरोगत: तिरोगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disappeared, vanished, out of sight. E. तिरस्, and गत gone.
तिरोधान: तिरोधान n. (-नं) 1 A cover or concealment, a sheath, a veil, a cloth or cloak, any thing which withholds another from sight. 2 Disappearance, the being hidden or the act of hiding or vanishing. E. तिरस् concealing, and धान having or holding.
तिरोहित: तिरोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Covered, concealed, hidden, removed or withdrawn from sight. E. तिरम् covering, धा to have, affix क्त.
तिर्यक्: तिर्य्यक् ind. Crookedly, awry: see तिर्य्यच्.
तिर्य्यक्: तिर्य्यक् ind. Crookedly, awry: see तिर्य्यच्.
तिर्यक्स्रोतस्: तिर्य्यक्स्रोतस् m. (-ताः) An animal, a beast or bird. E. तिर्य्यक् crookedly, and स्रोतस् motion.
तिर्य्यक्स्रोतस्: तिर्य्यक्स्रोतस् m. (-ताः) An animal, a beast or bird. E. तिर्य्यक् crookedly, and स्रोतस् motion.
तिर्यग्ज: तिर्य्यग्ज mfn. (-ग्जः-ग्जा-ग्जं) Born of an animal or insect. E. तिर्य्यच्, and ज born.
तिर्य्यग्ज: तिर्य्यग्ज mfn. (-ग्जः-ग्जा-ग्जं) Born of an animal or insect. E. तिर्य्यच्, and ज born.
तिर्यग्जाति: तिर्य्यग्जाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of the brute species, born as an animal. f. (-तिः) The brute kind. E. तिर्य्यच्, and जाति species.
तिर्य्यग्जाति: तिर्य्यग्जाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of the brute species, born as an animal. f. (-तिः) The brute kind. E. तिर्य्यच्, and जाति species.
तिर्यग्यवोदर: तिर्य्यग्यवोदर n. (-रं) A barley corn. E. तिर्य्यच् curved, यव barley, उदर the interior.
तिर्य्यग्यवोदर: तिर्य्यग्यवोदर n. (-रं) A barley corn. E. तिर्य्यच् curved, यव barley, उदर the interior.
तिर्यग्यान: तिर्य्यग्यान m. (-नः) A crab. E. तिर्य्यक् crookedly, and यान motion, going.
तिर्य्यग्यान: तिर्य्यग्यान m. (-नः) A crab. E. तिर्य्यक् crookedly, and यान motion, going.
तिर्यग्योनि: तिर्य्यग्योनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Born of or as an animal. E. तिर्य्यच्, and योनि place of birth.
तिर्य्यग्योनि: तिर्य्यग्योनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Born of or as an animal. E. तिर्य्यच्, and योनि place of birth.
तिर्यग्योन्यन्वय: तिर्य्यग्योन्यन्वय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of the brute kind. m. (-यः) The race or kind of animals, birds, &c. E. तिर्य्यग्योनि, and अन्वय race.
तिर्य्यग्योन्यन्वय: तिर्य्यग्योन्यन्वय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of the brute kind. m. (-यः) The race or kind of animals, birds, &c. E. तिर्य्यग्योनि, and अन्वय race.
तिर्यच्: तिर्य्यच् or तिर्य्यञ्च् mfn. (तिर्य्यङ् तिरञ्ची तिर्य्यक्) Moving tortuously, going crookedly or awry, (the neuter is also used adverbially: see तिर्य्यक्.) m. (-र्य्यङ्) 1 An animal, a quadruped. 2 A bird, or any animal moving tortuously. f. (-र्य्यञ्ची) The female of an animal, a beast or bird. E. तिरस् crookedly, अञ्च to go, affix क्विप्.
तिर्य्यच्: तिर्य्यच् or तिर्य्यञ्च् mfn. (तिर्य्यङ् तिरञ्ची तिर्य्यक्) Moving tortuously, going crookedly or awry, (the neuter is also used adverbially: see तिर्य्यक्.) m. (-र्य्यङ्) 1 An animal, a quadruped. 2 A bird, or any animal moving tortuously. f. (-र्य्यञ्ची) The female of an animal, a beast or bird. E. तिरस् crookedly, अञ्च to go, affix क्विप्.
तिल: तिल r. 1st cl. (तेलति) To go. r. 6th cl. (तिलति) and 10th cl. (तेलयति) 1 To be unctuous or greasy. 2 To oil or anoint.

तिल m. (-लः) 1 A plant bearing an oily seed; the oil and seed being both much used in Oriental cooking, (Sesamum orientale.) 2 A mole or spot, compared to a seed of sesamum. 3 A small particle or portion. E. तिल to be unctuous, affix क.
तिलक: तिलक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Spotted, freckled, a person having moles or spots. 2 Chief, principal. mn. (-कः-कं) A mark or marks made with coloured earths or unguents upon the forehead, and between the eye-brows, either as an ornament or a sectarial distinction. m. (-कः) 1 A freckle, a natural mark on the person. 2 A kind of tree, commonly Tila. 3 A sort of horse. 4 A title, especially in composition, implying pre-eminence, as रघुवंशतिलकः the Tilaka of the race of RAGHU, a name of RĀMA. n. (-कं) 1 The bladder. 2 Black Sochal salt, a factitious salt, containing sulphur and iron, &c. 3 A disease, the appearance of dark spots on the skin, unattended with inflammation. f. (-का) A kind of necklace. E. तिल sesamum, &c. कन् added, or तिल to go or be unctuous, and क्वुन् aff.
तिलकट: तिलकट m. (-टः) The farina of sesamum. E. तिल, and कटच् aff.
तिलकल्क: तिलकल्क n. (-ल्कं) Sesamum ground or bruised. E. तिल, and कल्क sediment.
तिलकालक: तिलकालक m. (-कः) 1 A mole, a spot on the body. 2 A man so marked. E. तिल sesamum seed, and काल black, कन् aff.
तिलकाश्रय: तिलकाश्रय m. (-यः) The forehead. E. तिलक, and आश्रय asylum.
तिलकिट्ट: तिलकिट्ट n. (-ट्टं) The sediment or cake of sesamum after the oil is expressed. E. तिल, and किट्ट sediment.
तिलकिन्: तिलकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) 1 Marked with the Tilaka. 2 Freckled, spotted. E. तिलक, and इनि aff.
तिलचूर्ण: तिलचूर्ण n. (-र्णं) Sesamum ground or pounded. E. तिल, and चूर्ण powder.
तिलतण्डुलक: तिलतण्डुलक n. (-कं) An embrace, embracing. E. तिल sesamum, and तण्डुल grain, कन् affix, as agreeable as rice mixed with sesamum.
तिलतैल: तिलतैल n. (-लं) Sesamum oil. E. तिल, and तैलच् aff.
तिलधेनु: तिलधेनु f. (-नुः) Sesamum made up in the shape of a cow, for the purpose of being presented to Brahmans, &c. E. तिल sesamum, and धेनु a cow.
तिलपर्ण: तिलपर्ण n. (-र्णं) 1 Sandal. 2 The leaf of the Tila tree. m. (-र्णः) Turpentine. E. तिल, and पर्ण a leaf.
तिलपर्णिका: तिलपर्णिका mfn. (-का) Red sanders: see the next. E. कन् added to तिलपर्णी.
तिलपर्णी: तिलपर्णी f. (-र्णी) Red sanders, (Pterocarpus santolinus.) E. तिल the sesamum plant, and पर्ण a leaf: see तैलपर्णी.
तिलपिच्चट: तिलपिच्चट n. (-टं) A sort of sweetmeat, made chiefly of ground sesamum.
तिलपिञ्ज: तिलपिञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) Barren sesamum, bearing no blossom, or its seed yielding no oil. E. तिल sesamum, and पिञ्ज affix, in this sense.
तिलपेज: तिलपेज m. (-जः) Barren sesamum: see the preceding. E. तिल sesamum, and पेज affix, with this sense.
तिलमय: तिलमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made or composed of sesamum. E. तिल, and मयट् aff.
तिलमयूर: तिलमयूर m. (-रः) A kind of peafowl. E. तिल, and मयूर a peacock: marked with spots resembling the seed of the sesamum.
तिलरस: तिलरस m. (-सः) Sesamum oil. E. तिल, and रस extract.
तिलस्नेह: तिलस्नेह n. (-हं) Oil, especially from sesamum. E. तिल, and स्नेह grease.
तिलहोम: तिलहोम n. (-मं) Burnt offering of sesamum. E. तिल, and होम burnt offering.
तिलापत्या: तिलापत्या f. (-त्या) A plant, bearing a small pungent seed, (Nigella Indica). E. तिल sesamum, and अपत्य offspring as it were, from the resemblance of the seeds.
तिलित्स: तिलित्स m. (-त्सः) A large snake, according to some, the same as the Gokhura, to others the Böa, (Böa constrictor.) E. तिलत् here said to imply motion, षो to destroy, and क affix, destroying life or loco-motion.
तिलोत्तमा: तिलोत्तमा f. (-मा) One of the courtezans of Svarga. E. तिल a mole, and उत्तम excellent, beautiful.
तिलोदक: तिलोदक n. (-कं) Sesamum seeds and water, as an oblation. E. तिल, and उदक water.
तिलौदन: तिलौदन n. (-नं) A dish of milk, rice, and sesamum. E. तिल sesamum, and ओदन boiled rice.
तिल्य: तिल्य n. (-ल्यं) A field of sesamum. E. तिल, with क्यप् aff.
तिल्ल: तिल्ल r. 1st cl. (तिल्लति) To go or move.
तिल्व: तिल्व m. (-ल्वः) A pale sort of Lodh: see लोध्र. E. तिल to anoint, and व affix; also with कन् added तिल्वक.
तिष्ठत्: तिष्ठत् mfn. (-ष्ठन्-ष्ठन्ती-ष्ठत्) Staying, abiding, standing, being. E. स्था to stay, &c. शतृ aff.
तिष्ठद्गु: तिष्ठद्गु n. (-द्गु) Evening, sun-set, the time which a cow stands to be milked, &c. E. स्था to stand, गौ a cow.
तिष्य: तिष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Auspicious, fortunate, lucky. m. (-ष्यः) 1 The eighth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion, an asterism figured by an arrow, and containing three stars, of which one is δ Cancri. 2 The month Pauṣa, (December-January.) 3 The Kali Yug. the fourth and present age. f. (-ष्या) Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.) E. तुष to please or delight, affix क्यप्, and इत् substituted for the penultimate.
तिष्यक: तिष्यक m. (-कः) The month Pauṣa: see the preceding. E. कन् added to तिष्य, the moon being then in that asterism.
तिष्यपुष्प: तिष्यपुष्प f. (-ष्पा) Emblic myrobalan. E. तिष्य auspicious, and पुष्प a flower.
तिष्यफला: तिष्यफला f. (-ला) Emblic myrobalan: see तिष्य. E. तिष्य auspicious, and फल fruit.
तिहन्: तिहन् m. (-हा) 1 Sickness. 2 Rice. 3 A bow. 4 A good disposition.
तीक: तीक (ऋ) तीकृ r. 1st cl. (तिकते) To go or move.
तीक्ष्ण: तीक्ष्ण mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं) 1 Hot, warm. 2 Hot, pungent. 3 Selfdevoted, self-abandoning, committing suicide, &c. 4 Zealous, active, warm. 5 Keen, intelligent. 6 Devout, ascetic, a devotee, a zealot. 7 Sharp, (as a sword.) n. (-क्ष्णं) 1 Heat, warmth. 2 Poison. 3 Iron. 4 War, battle. 5 Plague, pestilence, epidemic destruction. 6 Death, dying. 7 Any weapon. 8 Haste, hurry. 9 Sea salt. 10 The scrotum or testicles. 11 Any metal. 12 Pungency, the heat of pepper, &c. m. (-क्ष्णः) Nitre. f. (-क्ष्णा) 1 Orris root. 2 The cast skin of a snake. E. तिज to sharpen or be sharp, Uṇādi affix क्स्न.
तीक्ष्णक: तीक्ष्णक m. (-कः) 1 The scrotum or the testicles. 2 White mustard. E. कन् added to the preceding.
तीक्ष्णकण्टक: तीक्ष्णकण्टक m. (-कः) Thorn apple, (Datura metel.) E. तीक्ष्ण sharp, and कण्टक a thorn.
तीक्ष्णकन्द: तीक्ष्णकन्द m. (-न्दः) The onion. E. तीक्ष्ण pungent, and कन्द root.
तीक्ष्णकर्मन्: तीक्ष्णकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Active, zealous. E. तीक्ष्ण sharp, keen, and कर्म्मन् conduct.
तीक्ष्णकर्म्मन्: तीक्ष्णकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Active, zealous. E. तीक्ष्ण sharp, keen, and कर्म्मन् conduct.
तीक्ष्णगन्ध: तीक्ष्णगन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 Morunga hyperanthera. 2 The gum olibanum tree. 3 Small cardamoms. 4 A tree: see जियती. f. (-न्धा) Mustard seed. 2 Orris root. 3 Pandanus odoratissimus. E. तीक्ष्ण sharp, and गन्ध smell; also with कन् added तीक्ष्णगन्धक.
तीक्ष्णतण्डुला: तीक्ष्णतण्डुला f. (-ला) Long-pepper. E. तीक्ष्ण pungent, and तण्डल grain.
तीक्ष्णतैल: तीक्ष्णतैल n. (-लं) 1 Resin. 2 The milky juice of the Euphorbia. 3 Spirituous or vinous liquor. E. तीक्ष्ण hot, pungent, and तैल oil, unguent.
तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्र: तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A tiger. E. तीक्ष्ण sharp, and दंष्ट्र a tooth.
तीक्ष्णधार: तीक्ष्णधार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Sharp-edged, sharp. E. तीक्ष्ण, and धारा edge.
तीक्ष्णपत्र: तीक्ष्णपत्र m. (-त्रः) Coriander. E. तीक्ष्ण pungent, and पत्र a leaf.
तीक्ष्णपुष्प: तीक्ष्णपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Cloves. E. तीक्ष्ण pungent, and पुष्प flower.
तीक्ष्णफल: तीक्ष्णफल m. (-लः) Coriander. E. तीक्ष्ण pungent, and फल fruit, bearing pungent seeds.
तीक्ष्णरस: तीक्ष्णरस m. (-सः) Saltpetre. E. तीक्ष्ण sharp, and रस juice.
तीक्ष्णशूक: तीक्ष्णशूक m. (-कः) Barley. E. तीक्ष्ण sharp, and शूक awn.
तीक्ष्णाग्नि: तीक्ष्णाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Heartburn, dyspepsia. E. तीक्ष्ण, and अग्नि digestion.
तीक्ष्णायस: तीक्ष्णायस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Made of steel, sharp. n. (-सं) Steel. E. तीक्ष्ण, and अयस् iron, टच् added.
तीम: तीम r. 4th cl. (तीम्यति) To be wet or moist: see तिम.
तीर: तीर r. 10th cl. (तीरयति) To finish or complete, to get through or over.
तीर n. (-रं) 1 A shore, a bank. 2 An arrow. m. (-रः) Tin. f. (-री) A kind of arrow. E. तीर to get through or over, अच् aff.
तीरभुक्ति: तीरभुक्ति m. (-क्तिः) Tirhut, a province in the east of central Hindustan, lying on the north of Behar. E. तीर a bank, and भुक्ति here signifying a limit: being bounded on the west and east by the Gandaki and Kauśikī rivers, on the south by the Ganges, and on the north, by the skirts of the Himāla mountains.
तीरान्तर: तीरान्तर n. (-रं) The opposite bank or shore. E. तीर, and अन्तर beyond.
तीरित: तीरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Adjudged, settled, finished. n. (-तं) 1 Completion of any act or affair. 2 Corrupt or improper non-infliction of a sentence. E. तीर to get through, affix क्त.
तीर्ण: तीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Crossed, passed over. 2 Spread, expanded. 3 Surpassed, excelled. E. तॄ to pass, affix क्त.
तीर्णपदी: तीर्णपदी f. (-दी) A plant: see तालमूली. E. तीर्ण spreading, and पाद foot or root.
तीर्णवत्: तीर्णवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Crossed, having crossed. E. त to cross, affix क्तवतु.
तीर्थ: तीर्थ mn. (-र्थः-र्थं) 1 Sacred science, or any of the branches of knowledge esteemed holy. 2 A holy place, any place of pilgrimage, as Benares, &c. but especially particular spots along the course of sacred streams, as the Ganges, &c. and in the vicinity of some piece of water or sacred springs. 3 Any piece of water. 4 A Ghāt or stairs of a landing place. 5 A sacred preceptor, a Guru. 6 Sacrifice. 7 An Avatāra or descent of a deity. 8 A school of philosophy, a Darśana, a sect. 9 A counsellor, an adviser. 10 An expedient, a means of success. 11 The menses. 12 Pudendum muliebre. 13 A vessel. 14 A royal vessel. 15 A Brahman. 16 Ascertainment of disease. 17 Fire. 18 A part of the hand sacred to any  deity, as between the thumb and finger to the manes, the root of the thumb to BRAHMA, &c. E. तॄ to pass over, थक् Uṇādi affix; by which persons are extricated from sin, difficulty, &c.
तीर्थकर: तीर्थकर m. (-रः) One of the synonyms of a Jina or sanctified teacher of the Jaina sect. E. तीर्थ pure, purity, and कर who does or acts; also retaining the nasal तीर्थङ्कर.
तीर्थकृत्: तीर्थकृत् m. (-कृत्) A Jina: see the preceding.
तीर्थध्वाङ्क्ष: तीर्थध्वाङ्क्ष m. (-ङ्क्षः) An epithet of contempt, a crow, as it were, at a pilgrimage. E. तीर्थ, and ध्वाङ्क्ष a crow.
तीर्थराजी: तीर्थराजी f. (-जी) A name of Benāres. E. तीर्थ a holy place, and राजी the queen: the most eminent of the Tīrthas or places of pilgrimage.
तीर्थवाक: तीर्थवाक m. (-कः) A curl of hair. E. तीर्थ, and वच to speak, affix घञ्.
तीर्थसेविन्: तीर्थसेविन् mf. (-वी-विनी) 1 A pilgrim. 2 A sort of crane, (Ardea nivea.) E. तीर्थ, and सेविन् who frequents.
तीव: तीव r. 1st cl. (-तीवति) To be large, to be fat or corpulent.
तीवर: तीवर m. (-रः) 1 The ocean. 2 A hunter, one who lives by killing and selling game. 3 A fisherman, one who lives by fishing. f. (-री) The wife of a hunter. E. तॄ to go, to pass or cross, ष्वरच् aff.
तीव्र: तीव्र mfn. (-व्रः-व्रा-व्रं) 1 Much, excessive, endless, unbounded, unlimited. 2 Pungent. 3 Hot, warm. m. (-व्रः) A name of ŚIVA. f. (-व्रा) 1 A medicinal plant, Katuki. 2 Black mustard. 3 A sort of Dūrvā or bent grass, (गण्डदूर्व्वा) 4 The name of a river in the east of Bengal; also the Caṇḍī or Padmāvatī. adv. n. (-व्रं) 1 Much, excessively, endless. 2 Violently, fiercely. subst. 1 A shore, a bank. 2 Tin. 3 Heat. 4 Pungency. E. तीव to be large, &c. रक् aff.
तीव्रवेदना: तीव्रवेदना f. (-ना) Agony, excessive pain, the pain of damnation. E. तीव्र exceeding, and वेदना pain.
तु: तु r. 2nd cl. (तौति or तवति) 1 To go or move. 2 To thrive or increase. 3 To injure, to hurt or kill. 4 To become full. According to some authorities this is merely a Sautra root.
तु ind. A particle, implying. 1 Difference, (but, or.) 2 Disjunction, (but, again, further, other.) 3 Connexion, (and, moreover.) 4 Asseveration, (indeed.) 5 An expletive.
तुकाक्षीरी: तुकाक्षीरी f. (-री) The manna of bambus; also तुगा and सुगाक्षीरी.
तुगा: तुगा f. (-गा) The manna of bambus.
तुङ्ग: तुङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 High, elevated, lofty. 2 Chief, principal. 3 Passionate, hot. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A tree, (Rottleria tinctoria.) 2 A mountain. 3 The planet Mercury. 4 The superior apsis or aphelion of a planet. 5 Top, vertex, altitude. 6 The cocoanut tree. f. (-ङ्गी) 1 A kind of basil, (Ocymum gratissimum.) 2 Turmerick. 3 Night. f. (-ङ्गा) Bambu manna. E. तुजि to guard, to dwell, to hurt, &c. affix घञ्.
तुङ्गक: तुङ्गक m. (-कः) A tree, (Rottleria tinctoria.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
तुङ्गता: तुङ्गता f. (-ता) 1 Loftiness. 2 Passionateness. E. तल् added to तुङ्ग; also with त्व, तुङ्गत्व.
तुङ्गभद्र: तुङ्गभद्र m. (-द्रः) A restive elephant or one in rut. f. (-द्रा) A river in the Mysur country, the Toombhadra. E. तुङ्ग lofty, tall, &c. and भद्र auspicious.
तुङ्गशेखर: तुङ्गशेखर m. (-रः) A mountain. E. तुङ्ग lofty, and शेखर crest or summit.
तुङ्गिन्: तुङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) High, lofty. m. (-ङ्गी) A planet at the apex of its orbit, or of its position, with regard to others considered astrologically. E. तुङ्ग, and इनि aff.
तुङ्गीपति: तुङ्गीपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. तुङ्गी night, and पति master.
तुङ्गीश: तुङ्गीश m. (-शः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 The moon. 3 The sun. 4 A name of KṚṢṆA. E. तुङ्गी night, or तुङ्ग a mountain, &c. and ईश lord.
तुच्छ: तुच्छ mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं) 1 Void, empty. 2 Small, little. 3 Abandoned, deserted. 4 Low, contemptible. n. (-च्छं) Chaff. E. तुल to weigh, Uṇādi affix छ.
तुच्छधान्यक: तुच्छधान्यक n. (-कं) Straw. E. तुच्छ, and धान्यक grain.
तुच्छद्रु: तुच्छद्रु m. (-द्रुः) The castor oil tree. E. तुच्छ empty, pithless, द्रु a tree; having no sap.
तुज्: तुज् m. (तुक्) Offspring, children. E. तुज to guard, affix क्विप्.
तुज: तुज r. 1st cl. (तोजति) To kill or hurt. (इ) तुजि r. 1st cl. (तुञ्जति) To guard or protect. r. 1st and 10th cls. (तुञ्जति तुञ्जयति) 1 To dwell, to abide. 2 To be strong or vigorous. 3 To give. 4 To hurt, to injure or kill. 5 To shine.
तुञ्ज: तुञ्ज mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) Noxious, mischievous. m. (-ञ्जः) A Daitya, a demon. E. तुजि to hurt, affix अच्.
तुट: तुट r. 6th cl. (तुटति) 1 To dispute, to quarrel, to wrangle. 2 To hurt or injure.
तुटुम: तुटुम m. (-मः) A rat. E. तुट to injure, affix उम.
तुड: तुड (ऋ) तुडृ (तोडति) also (इ) तुडि r. 1st cl. (तुण्डते) also तुड r. 6th cl. (तुडति) 1 To tear, to break or cut, to pull to pieces, to hurt or kill.
तुण: तुण r. 6th cl. (तुणति) 1 To curve, to bend or make crooked. 2 To act fraudulently.
तुणि: तुणि m. (-णिः) A timber tree: see तुन्न. E. तूण to shrink or warp, affix कि, and the radical vowel made short.
तुण्ड: तुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The mouth, the face. E. तुडि to tear, (food, &c.) affix अण्, and कन् being added तुण्डक.
तुण्डकेरी: तुण्डकेरी f. (-री) A cucurbitaceous plant, (Momordica monadelpha.) E. तुण्डक the mouth, ऋ to go, अण् and ङीष् affs.
तुण्डि: तुण्डि mf. (-ण्डिः-ण्डी) 1 The mouth, the face. 2 A beak. 3 The navel; (also तुन्दि.) E. तुडि to break or destroy, Uṇādi affix इन्.
तुण्डिका: तुण्डिका f. (-का) 1 The navel. 2 A plant, commonly Telakuca. E. कन् added to तुण्डी.
तुण्डिकेरी: तुण्डिकेरी f. (-री) 1 The cotton plant. 2 A sort of gourd, (Momordica monadelpha.) 2 A large boil or swelling on the palate. E. तुण्डिका the mouth or beak, ऋ to go, affixes अण् and ङीष्; also with कन् added तुण्डिकेरिका. f. (-का) and with इन् fem. affix तुण्ठिकेरि. f. (-रिः) also तुण्डकेरी and तुण्डिकेशी.
तुण्डिकेशी: तुण्डिकेशी f. (-शी) A sort of gourd, commonly Telakuca: see the preceding.
तुण्डिभ: तुण्डिभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Having a prominent or elevated navel. E. तुण्डि the navel, भ affix; also तुन्दिभ, &c.
तुण्डिल: तुण्डिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Having a prominent or elevated navel. 2 Speaking harshly or severely. E. तुण्डि the navel, and ल affix; also तुन्दिल, &c.
तुत्थ: तुत्थ r. 10th cl. (तुत्थयति) 1 To screen, to veil, to cover. 2 To spread.

तुत्थ m. (-त्थः) Fire. f. (-त्था) 1 Indigo. 2 Small cardamoms. n. (-त्थं) 1 A collyrium extracted from the Amomum zanthorrhiza. 2 Blue vitriol, sulphate of copper, especially medicinally considered as an Añjana, or application to the eyes. E. तुद to pain, थक् Uṇādi aff.
तुत्थक: तुत्थक n. (-कं) Blue vitriol. E. कन् added to तुत्थ.
तुत्थाञ्जन: तुत्थाञ्जन n. (-नं) Blue vitriol, considered as a medicinal application to the eyes. E. तुत्थ the same, and अञ्जन a collyrium.
तुद: तुद (औ) r. 6th cl. (तुदति-ते) To pain, to wound, to vex or harass, to tease, to torture or torment, (इ) तुदि r. 1st cl. (तुन्दति) To search, to seek.
तुन्द: तुन्द n. (-न्दं) The belly. f, (-न्दी) The navel: see तुण्डि. E. तुद to torment, क affix, and नुम् augment.
तुन्दकूपी: तुन्दकूपी f. (-पी) The navel. E. तुन्द the belly, and कूप a pit, a well, dim. affix ङीष्; also with कन् added तुन्दकूर्पिका, f. (-का.)
तुन्दपरिमार्ज: तुन्दपरिमार्ज m. (-र्जः) A lazy man, a sloth, a sluggard: see the next.
तुन्दपरिमृज: तुन्दपरिमृज m. (-जः) A lazy man, a sluggard. E. तुन्द the belly, मृज to rub, with परि prefixed, and क affix; also with the affix घञ्, तुन्दपरिमार्ज as above; passing his whole time in stroking his sides.
तुन्दवत्: तुन्दवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Corpulent, fat. E. तुन्द, and मतुप् aff. also from तुन्दि, तुन्दिवत्.
तुन्दि: तुन्दि n. (-न्दि) The belly. f. (-न्दिः) The navel. m. (-न्दिः) One of the Gandharbas or quiristers of Svarga. E. तुद to vex or harass, affix इन्, and नुम् inserted.
तुन्दिक: तुन्दिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having a large or prominent navel, fat, corpulent. f. (-का) The navel. E. तुन्दी the navel, कन् affix, or तुन्द with ठन् aff.
तुन्दित: तुन्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having a large or prominent navel. E. तुन्द with इतच् affix; also तुन्दिक, तुन्दिल, &c.
तुन्दिन्: तुन्दिन् mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि) Having a large or prominent navel. E. तुन्द with इनि affix; also तुन्दिक, &c.
तुन्न: तुन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Tormented, vexed, injured. 2 Cut, broken, cut down, &c. m. (-न्नः) Toon or Tuna, a tree of which the wood bears some resemblance to mahogany, and is used for furniture, &c. (Cedrela tunna.) E. तुद to vex, affix क्त.
तुन्नवाय: तुन्नवाय m. (-यः) A tailor. E. तुन्न cut, (cloth, &c.) and वे to sew, affix अण्.
तुन्नसेवनी: तुन्नसेवनी f. (-नी) A suture of the skull. E. तुन्न cut, and सेवनी a suture.
तुप: तुप r. 1st 6th and 10 cls. (तोपति, तुपति, तोपयति) also (इ) तुपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (तुम्पति तुम्पयति) To injure, to hurt or kill; also तुफ, तुम्ब, तुम्प, &c.
तुफ: तुफ r. 1st, 6th and 10th cls. (तोफति तुफति तोफयति) To hurt or kill.
तुब: तुब (इ) तुबि r. 1st and 10th cls. (तुम्बति तुम्बयति) To kill or hurt. r. 10th cl. (तुम्बयति) To disappear.
तुभ: तुभ r. 1st cl. (तोभते) 4th cl. (तुभ्यति) 9th cl. (तुभ्नाति) To kill, to hurt, to injure in any manner.
तुमुर: तुमुर mn. (-रः-रं) Mingled combat: see तुमुल.
तुमुल: तुमुल mn. (-लः-लं) 1 Mingled or tumultuous combat. 2 Uproar, clangour, tumult, tumultuous sound or noise. m. (-लः) Beleric myrobalan. E. तु a Sautra root, to kill, to injure, &c. मुलक affix; or with the vowel long तुमूल. mn. (-लः-लं) and ल being changed to र, तुमुर as above.
तुम्प: तुम्प r. 1st and 6th cls. (तुम्पति) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To be distressed.
तुम्फ: तुम्फ r. 1st cl. (तुम्फति) To hurt or kill.
तुम्ब: तुम्ब mf. (-म्बः-म्बा or म्बी) A long gourd, &c. see तुम्बि f. (-म्बा) A cow disposed to be milked. E. तुबि to destroy, (bile, &c.) affix अच्.
तुम्बक: तुम्बक m. (-कः) A long gourd. n. (-कं) The gourd. E. कन् added to the preceding: see तुम्बि.
तुम्बि: तुम्बि f. (-म्बिः or तुम्बी) A long gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaris.) E. तुबि to destroy, (bile, sickness, &c.) अच् affix; fem. affix इन् or ङीष्; also with कन् added तुम्बिका.
तुम्बीपुष्प: तुम्बीपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) The flower of the Cucurbita lagenaris. E. तुम्बी, and पुष्प a flower.
तुम्बुरी: तुम्बुरी f. (-री) 1 Coriander. 2 A bitch: see तुम्बुरु.
तुम्बुरु: तुम्बुरु m. (-रुः) 1 One of the Gandharbas or singers of heaven. 2 A celestial inhabitant and attendant upon the sanctified Jaina teachers. n. (-रुः) Coriander. E. तुबि to hurt, &c. उरन् affix; also with the pen. long तुम्बूरु.
तुर: तुर r. 3rd cl. (तुतोर्त्ति) To go quick, to hurry, to make haste; this root is restricted to the Vedas: see त्वर.
तुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Quick, swift. E. तुर to make haste, क aff.
तुरग: तुरग m. (-गः) 1 A horse. 2 The mind. E. त्वर speed, velocity, and ग what goes, व changed to उ. f. (-गी) 1 A plant, (Physalis flexuosa:) see अश्वगन्ध. 2 A mare. E. ङीष् added to तुरग.
तुरगगन्धा: तुरगगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant: see the preceding. E. तुरग a horse, and गन्ध small, smelling like a horse; also अश्वगन्ध, &c.
तुरगब्रह्मचर्यक: तुरगब्रह्मचर्य्यक n. (-कं) Necessary celibacy, leading a life of continence, in consequence merely of being without female society. E. तुरग a horse, and ब्रह्मचर्य्यक the practice of a religious student, one of whose duties is continence.
तुरगब्रह्मचर्य्यक: तुरगब्रह्मचर्य्यक n. (-कं) Necessary celibacy, leading a life of continence, in consequence merely of being without female society. E. तुरग a horse, and ब्रह्मचर्य्यक the practice of a religious student, one of whose duties is continence.
तुरगिन्: तुरगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Equestrian, riding, mounted or carried on a horse. m. (-गी) A horseman, cavalier, &c. E. तुरग a horse, and इनि aff.
तुरङ्ग: तुरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A horse. 2 The mind, considered as the seat of feeling as well as intellect, the heart. E. त्वर speedily, and ग what goes. f. (-ङ्गी) 1 A plant: see तुरगी and तुरगगन्धा. 2 A mare. E. ङीष् added to the preceding.
तुरङ्गक: तुरङ्गक m. (-कः) A plant, a kind of Ghosha, commonly हस्तिघोष. E. तुरङ्ग a horse, and कन् affix of analogy; coursing through the body.
तुरङ्गद्विषणी: तुरङ्गद्विषणी f. (-णी) A she buffalo. E. तुरङ्ग, and द्विषणी disliking.
तुरङ्गप्रिय: तुरङ्गप्रिय m. (-यः) Barley. E. तुरङ्ग, and प्रिय fond of.
तुरङ्गम: तुरङ्गम m. (-मः) A horse. E. त्वर speed, and गम to go, with खच् aff.
तुरङ्गयायिन्: तुरङ्गयायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Going on horseback. E. तुरङ्ग, and यायिन् who goes.
तुरङ्गवक्त्र: तुरङ्गवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) A Kinnara or quirister of INDRA'S heaven. E. तुरङ्ग a horse, and वक्त्र a face.
तुरङ्गवदन: तुरङ्गवदन m. (-नः) A celestial quirister. E. तुरङ्ग a horse, and वदन a face; these beings are described as having the bodies of men, and the heads of horses; also similar compounds, as तुरङ्गानन, तुरङ्गवक्त्र, तुगङ्गास्य, अश्ववक्त्र, &c.
तुरङ्गारि: तुरङ्गारि m. (-रिः) 1 A buffalo. 2 Oleander. E. तुरङ्ग, and अरि foe.
तुरङ्गिन्: तुरङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) 1 A horseman, a rider. 2 A groom. E. तुरङ्ग, and इनि aff.
तुरायण: तुरायण subst. mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Attachment to any object or pursuit. adj. Attached to any object or pursuit. m. (-णः) A particular sacrifice. E. त्वर speed, haste, अय to go, affix ल्यु; speeding towards a given end or in a certain cause: see परायण.
तुरासाह्: तुरासाह् m. (-षाट् or षाड्) A name of INDRA. E. तुर for त्वर haste, सह to bear, in the causal form, and क्विप् affix, स being changed to ष in inflexion.
तुरि: तुरि f. (-रिः) See the next; also तुलि.
तुरी: तुरी f. (-री) 1 A brush or a fibrous stick used by weavers to clean and separate the threads of the woof. 2 A painter's brush, &c.: see तुली.
तुरीय: तुरीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fourth, a fourth. m. (-यः) A fourth part, a quarter. n. (-यं) The divine being, or universal spirit. E. irr. derived from चतुर् four, with छ affix; also तूर्य्य and तुर्य्य.
तुरीयभाग: तुरीयभाग m. (-गः) A fourth part or share. E. तुरीय, and भाग share.
तुरीयभाज्: तुरीयभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) A sharer of a fourth. E. तुरीय, and भाज who divides.
तुरीयवर्ण: तुरीयवर्ण m. (-र्णः) The Śūdra or fourth tribe of the Hindus. E. तुरीय fourth, and वर्ण tribe.
तुरीयांश: तुरीयांश m. (-शः) A fourth part, a quarter share. E. तुरीय, and अंश a share.
तुरुष्क: तुरुष्क m. (-ष्कः) 1 Incense. 2 A country, or m. plu. (-ष्काः) Its inhabitants; Turan or Turkestan, the original country of the Turks. E. तुर to haste, (into smoke, &c.) affix उस्, and कन् added.
तुर्य: तुर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Fourth. E. irr. derived from चतुर् four, with यत् aff.
तुर्य्य: तुर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Fourth. E. irr. derived from चतुर् four, with यत् aff.
तुर्व: तुर्व (इ) तुर्वी r. 1st cl. (तुर्वति) To hurt, to injure, to kill.
तुर्वसु: तुर्व्वसु m. (-सुः) One of the sons of YAYĀTI, king of the south and eastern portion of India, reigning over the Mleccha tribes
तुर्व्वसु: तुर्व्वसु m. (-सुः) One of the sons of YAYĀTI, king of the south and eastern portion of India, reigning over the Mleccha tribes
तुल: तुल r. 1st and 10th cls. (तोलति तुलति तोलयति-ते or irr. तुलयति) To weigh or measure.
तुलयित्वा: तुलयित्वा ind. Having weighed, having counterpoised, made equal or like, &c. E. तुल to weigh, क्त्वा aff.
तुलसी: तुलसी f. (-सी) A small shrub held in veneration by the Hindus, Tulasi or holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum.) E. तुला resemblance, and षो to destroy, affixes ङ and ङीप्; being unparalleled: this plant is said to be a female metamorphosed.
तुला: तुला f. (-ला) 1 Measure by weight. 2 A measure or weight of gold and silver, 100 Palas, or about 145 ounces troy. 3 A balance, especially a fine balance, goldsmith's or assay scales. 4 The sign of the zodiac, Libra. 5 Resemblance, likeness, equality, similarity. 6 A vessel. 7 Sloping beams or timbers in the roof of a house. E. तुल to weigh or to resemble, affixes क and टाप्.
तुलाकोटि: तुलाकोटि f. (-टिः-टी) 1 An ornament of the feet or toes. 2 A certain weight. 3 A hundred millions. E. तुला a balance, कुट to measure, affix अच् and इ or ङीष्; what is valued by weight, &c. or तुला a measure, &c. and कोटि Crore, or million.
तुलाकोश: तुलाकोश m. (-शः) A sort of ordeal, in which the accused is tried by being weighed repeatedly in a scale: if he is lighter the second time he is pronounced innocent; if equipoised still, or heavier, he is guilty. E. तुला a scale, and कोश ordeal.
तुलाधट: तुलाधट m. (-टः) 1 An oar, a paddle. 2 The scale or cup of a balance. E. तुला, and धट a scale.
तुलाधर: तुलाधर m. (-रः) The sun. E. तुला the sign, and धर who has or possesses.
तुलाधार: तुलाधार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) A trader, a dealer, trafficking, trading. m. (-रः) 1 The sign Libra. 2 The string of a balance. 3 The beam. E. तुला the scales, &c. आधार what or who supports.
तुलापरीक्षा: तुलापरीक्षा f. (-क्षा) Ordeal by the balance, the weight of the accused being first taken, certain prayers and ceremonies are performed, after which he is weighed again: if lighter, he is innocent; if heavy, or as at first, guilty. E. तुला, and परीक्षा test.
तुलापुरुष: तुलापुरुष m. (-षः) A person weighed in a balance, or an effigy of him used as a weight. E. तुला, and पुरुष a man.
तुलापुरुषदान: तुलापुरुषदान n. (-नं) Gift of gold or valuables of the weight of the donor. E. तुलापुरुष, and दान gift.
तुलाप्रग्रह: तुलाप्रग्रह m. (-हः) The string of a balance. E. तुला, and प्रग्रह holding; also तुलाप्रग्राह.
तुलामान: तुलामान n. (-नं) Measure by weight. E. तुला, and मान measure.
तुलावीज: तुलावीज n. (-जं) The Gunjā or berry of the Abrus precatorius, from which the goldsmith's or jeweller's weight in India is taken; the berry weighs about 1(5/16) grain troy, the factitious weight about 2(3/16). E. तुला weight, and वीज seed.
तुलासूत्र: तुलासूत्र n. (-त्रं) The string of a balance. E. तुला, and सूत्र thread.
तुलि: तुलि f. (-लिः or -ली) 1 A fibrous stick or brush used by weavers for cleaning the threads of the woof. 2 A painter's brush, or fibrous stick used for that purpose: see तूलिका. E. तुल to resemble, &c. affix क, fem. affix इन् or ङीष्; also with ल changed to र, तुरि, तुरी.
तुलिका: तुलिका f. (-का) A small bird said to resemble the wagtail.
तुलित: तुलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made equal or like, equalled, compared. 2 Weighed, counterpoised. E. तुल to weigh, क्त aff.
तुलिफला: तुलिफला f. (-ला) The Simul or silk cotton tree. E. तुलि for तूलि cotton, and फल fruit.
तुल्य: तुल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Like, resembling, equal or analogous to. E. तुला resemblance, and यत् aff.
तुल्यता: तुल्यता f. (-ता) Likeness, sameness, equality. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, तुल्यत्वं.
तुल्यपान: तुल्यपान n. (-नं) Drinking together. E. तुल्य alike, and पान drinking.
तुल्यबल: तुल्यबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of equal strength. E. तुल्य, and बल strength.
तुल्यभावन: तुल्यभावन n. (-नं) Combination of like series, (in calculation.) E. तुल्य, and भावनं computing.
तुल्यरूप: तुल्यरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पी-पं) 1 Like, similar, analogous. 2 Of like or equal form. E. तुल्य, and रूप nature, &c.
तुल्यवृत्ति: तुल्यवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Following the same or similar occupation. E. तुल्य, and वृत्ति business.
तुल्यशुद्धि: तुल्यशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Equal subtraction, transposition, (in Arithmetic.) E. तुल्य, and शुद्धि subtraction.
तुल्याकृति: तुल्याकृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Alike, of the same form. E. तुल्य, and आकृति form.
तुवर: तुवर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Astringent. 2 Beardless. mn. (-रः-रं) An astringent taste. f. (-री) 1 A fragrant earth. 2 A kind of lentil, (Cytisus cajan:) see आढकी. E. तु a Sautra root, to remove, (disease, &c.) थ्वरच् and affix ङीष्; also कन् being added, in the fem. form तुवरिका, f. (-का.)
तुवरोशिम्ब: तुवरोशिम्ब m. (-म्बः) A kind of cassia. E. तुवरी the pulse so called, and शिम्ब Cassia tora.
तुवि: तुवि f. (-विः) A long gourd: see तुम्बी.
तुष: तुष r. 4th cl. (ञि, औ) ञिऔतुष (तुष्यति) To be satisfied or content, to be pleased or delighted.
तुष mf. (-षः-षा) 1 The husk or chaff of rice, &c. 2 Beleric myrobalan. E. तुष to please or be pleased, affix क.
तुषग्रह: तुषग्रह m. (-हः) Agni or fire. E. तुष chaff, and ग्रह who seizes.
तुषसार: तुषसार m. (-रः) Agni or fire. E. तुष chaff, and सार who embraces, from सृ to go, with अण् aff.
तुषानल: तुषानल m. (-लः) 1 A conflagration of chaff, or of the husk of corn. 2 A capital punishment, burning; twisting dry straw, &c. round the limbs of a criminal, and setting it on fire. E. तुष, and अनल fire.
तुषार: तुषार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cold, frigid, frosty. m. (-रः) 1 Frost. 2 Cold. 3 Thin rain, mist. 4 Ice or snow. 5 The name of a country. E. तुष to please, Uṇādi affix आरन्.
तुषारकण: तुषारकण m. (-णः) 1 A dew drop. 2 An icicle. 3 Hoar frost. E. तुषार, and कण a particle.
तुषारकाल: तुषारकाल m. (-लः) Winter, the cold season. E. तुषार, and काल time.
तुषारपात: तुषारपात m. (-तः) 1 Thin rain, a sprinkling, a shower. 2 A fall of snow. E. तुषार, and पात falling.
तुषाराद्रि: तुषाराद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The Himālaya mountain. E. तुषार, and अद्रि a mountain; also similar compounds, as तुषारपर्व्वत, तुषारशैल, &c.
तुषित: तुषित m. (-तः) A Tuṣita, a kind of subordinate deity, one of a class of thirty-six. E. तुष to please, इतच् aff.
तुषोदक: तुषोदक n. (-कं) Rice gruel. E. तुष to satisfy, and उदक water.
तुष्ट: तुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Pleased, satisfied. E. तुष to be pleased, affix क्त.
तुष्टि: तुष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Pleasure, satisfaction, gratification, content. 2 Indifference to every thing but that possessed or obtained. 3 One of the Mātṛs. E. तुष to please, &c. affix क्तिन्.
तुष्टिकर: तुष्टिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Pleasing, satisfying. E. तुष्टि, and कर what makes.
तुष्टिजनन: तुष्टिजनन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Gratifying, giving or producing satisfaction. E. तुष्टि, and जनन birth.
तुष्टिद: तुष्टिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Pleasing, satisfying. E. तुष्टि, and द what gives.
तुष्टु: तुष्टु m. (-ष्टुः) A jewel worn in the ears. E. तुष to please, क्तु aff.
तुष्ट्वा: तुष्ट्वा ind. Having pleased or gratified. E. तुष, and क्त्वा aff.
तुस: तुस m. (-सः) The husk of corn or rice: see तुष.
तुस्त: तुस्त n. (-स्तं) Dust. E. तुस to sound, affix क्त: see तूस्त.
तुह: तुह (इर) तुहिर r. 1st cl. (तोहति) To hurt or give pain, to kill.
तुहिन: तुहिन n. (-नं) 1 Frost. 2 Moon-light, moonshine. E. तुह to give pain, इनन् Uṇādi aff.
तुहिनशैल: तुहिनशैल m. (-लः) The Himālaya mountains. E. तुहिन, and शैल a mountain; also similar compounds, as तुहिनपर्व्वत, &c.
तुहिनांशु: तुहिनांशु m. (-शुः) The moon. E. तुहिन cold, अंशु a ray.
तुहिनांशुतैल: तुहिनांशुतैल n. (-लं) Camphor. E. तुहिनांशु, and तैल oil.
तुहिनाद्रि: तुहिनाद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The Himālaya mountains. E. तुहिन, and अद्रि a mountain; also तुहिनशैल, &c.
तूण: तूण r. 1st cl. (तूणयते) To fill, to fill up. (तूणयति) To shrink, to contract, to close as the eye-lids or wink.
तूण mfn. (-णः-णा or -णी) A quiver, &c. f. (-णी) Indigo. E. तूण to be filled (with arrows, &c.) अच् and टाप् affixes, or घञ् and ङीष्.
तूणक: तूणक n. (-कं) A measure of verse, species of the अतिशर्करी metre.
तूणिन्: तूणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) Having a quiver, quivered. m. (-णी) The Tūn tree. E. तूण, and इनि aff.
तूणीर: तूणीर m. (-रः) A quiver. E. तूण to be filled (with arrows), ईरण् aff.
तूनी: तूनी f. (-नी) Sharp pain in the perinœum and lower part of the abdomen.
तूर्: तूर् f. (-तूः) Speed. m. (-तूः) A courier. E. त्वर to make haste, क्विप् affix, and the semivowel changed to ऊ.
तूर: तूर (ई) तूरी r. 4th cl. (तूर्य्यते) To go quick, to make haste. 2 To kill, to hurt or injure.
तूर n. (-रं) Any musical instrument. f. (-री) A trumpet. E. त्वर to speed, affix अच्.
तूर्ण: तूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Quick, expeditious. n. adv. (-र्णं) Quick, swift, quickly. E. त्वर to go swiftly, affix क्त.
तूर्णि: तूर्णि m. (-र्णिः) 1 Speed, velocity, expedition. 2 Dirt, excrement. 3 A stanza. 4 The mind. E. त्वर to make haste, Uṇādi affix नि.
तूर्य: तूर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Fourth: see तुर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Any musical instrument, the genus of which four species are reckoned, as wind instruments, stringed instruments, &c. E. चतुर four, यत् deriv. irr.
तूर्य्य: तूर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Fourth: see तुर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Any musical instrument, the genus of which four species are reckoned, as wind instruments, stringed instruments, &c. E. चतुर four, यत् deriv. irr.
तूर्यखण्ड: तूर्य्यखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A musical instrument, a sort of tabor.
तूर्य्यखण्ड: तूर्य्यखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A musical instrument, a sort of tabor.
तूल: तूल r. 1st cl. (तूलति) 1 To dismiss, to send forth or turn out. 2 To ascertain quantity or weight; some make this a root of the tenth class (तूलयति-ते.)

तूल n. (-लं) 1 The mulberry, (Morus Indica.) 2 Æther, the heaven or atmosphere. mn. (-लः-लं) Cotton. f. (-ला-ली) The wick of a lamp, or cotton twisted into a similar form for applying unguents, &c. (-ली) 1 Indigo. 2 A weaver's fibrous stick or brush. 3 A painter's brush, &c. see तुली and तुरी; also तूलि. E. तूल to dismiss, to send forth, affix घञ्, fem. affixes टाप् and ङीष्.
तूलक: तूलक n. (-कं) Cotton. E. कन् added to the preceding.
तूलकार्मुक: तूलकार्म्मुक n. (-कं) A bow which is used for cleaning cotton. E. तूल cotton, and कार्म्मुक a bow; also similar compounds, as तूलचाप, तूलधनुः, &c.
तूलकार्म्मुक: तूलकार्म्मुक n. (-कं) A bow which is used for cleaning cotton. E. तूल cotton, and कार्म्मुक a bow; also similar compounds, as तूलचाप, तूलधनुः, &c.
तूलनाली: तूलनाली f. (-ली) A thick roll of cotton, from which it is drawn out in spinning. E. तूल cotton, नाल a tube, affixes अण् and ङीप्; also with कन् added तूलनालिका, f. (-का.)
तूलपिचु: तूलपिचु m. (-चुः) Cotton. E. तूल cotton, and पिचु the same.
तूलशर्करा: तूलशर्करा f. (-रा) A pod or seed of the plant, any seed yielding a similar substance. E. तूल cotton, and शर्करा sand or gravel.
तूलसेचन: तूलसेचन n. (-नं) Spinning. E. तूल cotton, सिच to sprinkle, and ल्युट् aff.
तूलि: तूलि f. (-लिः) A painter's brush, or a fibrous stick used as one, and for other purposes. E. तूल to send forth or cut, affix इन्: see तूल and तूली.
तूलिका: तूलिका f. (-का) 1 A pencil, a painter's brush, or a stick with a fibrous extremity used as one. 2 A mattress or quilt, a bed, a down or cotton bed. 3 An ingot mould. 4 A rod, &c. dipped into crucibles to try if their contents are in fusion. 5 A wick or twist of cotton either for a lamp or for applying unguents, &c. E. तूली as above, and कन् added.
तूलिनी: तूलिनी f. (-नी) The silk cotton tree. E. तूल cotton, इनि and ङीष् aff.
तूवर: तूवर m. (-रः) 1 A bull without horns, though of an age to have them. 2 A beardless man. 3 A eunuch. 4 An astringent taste. f. (-री) A fragrant earth. E. तु to injure, ष्वरच् affix, and the vowel optionally long, hence also तुवर and तुवरी; with कन् added तूवरिका and तूवरीका.
तूष: तूष r. 1st cl. (तूषति) 1 To satisfy. 2 To be satisfied or happy.
तूष्णींशील: तूष्णींशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Silent, taciturn. E. तूष्णीम् silent, and शील practising.
तूष्णीक: तूष्णीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Silent, taciturn. E. तूष्णीम् silent, अकच् affix, and म dropped.
तूष्णीकाम्: तूष्णीकाम् ind. Silent, silently. E. तूष्णीम् silent, and काम् aff.
तूष्णीम्: तूष्णीम् ind. Silent, silently. E. तुष to please or be pleased, affix नीम्, and उ made long.
तूष्णीम्भूत: तूष्णीम्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Silent. E. तूष्णीम्, and भूत become.
तूस्त: तूस्त n. (-स्तं) 1 Dust. 2 Clotted hair. 3 Sin. 4 An atom, a very thin or delicate substance. E. तूस to sound, Uṇādi affix तन्, and the radical vowel made long.
तृक्ष: तृक्ष r. 1st cl. (तृक्षति) To go, to move or approach.
तृढ: तृढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Hurt, injured, wounded. E. तृह to hurt, क्त aff.
तृण: तृण (उ) तृणु r. 8th cl. (तर्णोति तर्णुते or तृणोति तृणुते) To eat, especially grass, to graze.
तृण n. (-णं) Grass, any gramineous plant. E. तृह to hurt, Uṇādi affix क्न, and ह rejected; what is consumed by cattle, &c.
तृणकुङ्कुम: तृणकुङ्कुम n. (-मं) A sort of perfume. E. तृण grass, कुङ्कुम saffron.
तृणकुटी: तृणकुटी f. (-टी) A hovel, a hut of grass or straw. E. तृण grass, and कुटी a small house.
तृणकूर्म: तृणकूर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) A long gourd, (Cueurbita lagenaria.) E. तृण grass, and कूर्म्म a tortoise.
तृणकूर्म्म: तृणकूर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) A long gourd, (Cueurbita lagenaria.) E. तृण grass, and कूर्म्म a tortoise.
तृणकेतु: तृणकेतु m. (-तुः) A bambu. E. तृण grass, and केतु a banner.
तृणगोधा: तृणगोधा f. (-धा) 1 A kind of newt. 2 A chameleon. 3 A worm. E. तृण grass, and गोधा a lizard.
तृणग्राहिन्: तृणग्राहिन् m. (-ही) 1 Amber, &c. or any gem which being rubbed becomes electrically attractive. 2 Sapphire. E. तृण grass, and ग्राहिन् what seizes.
तृणजम्भ: तृणजम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) 1 Graminivorous, one whose food is grass. 2 Grass-toothed, having teeth of the colour of grass, &c. E. तृण grass, and जम्भ food, or a tooth.
तृणजाति: तृणजाति m. (-तिः) The vegetable kingdom. E. तृण, and जाति genus.
तृणता: तृणता f. (-ता) 1 A bow. 2 The aggregate properties of grass or herbage, gramineousness. E. तल् affix of the abstract, added to तृण; also तृणत्व, n. (-त्वं.)
तृणद्रुम: तृणद्रुम m. (-मः) A palm tree, any of the various species, as the palmyra, cocoanut, date, &c. E. तृण grass, and द्रुम a tree; pre-eminent amongst gramineous plants.
तृणधान्य: तृणधान्य m. (-न्यः) Grain growing wild or without cultivation. E. तृण grass, and धान्य grain, corn.
तृणध्वज: तृणध्वज m. (-जः) A bambu. E. तृण grass, and ध्वज a flag or banner.
तृणपूली: तृणपूली f. (-ली) A mat, a seat made of reeds or basket-work. E. तृण grass, पूल to gather together, affixes अण् and ङीष्.
तृणमणि: तृणमणि m. (-णिः) A sort of gem, apparently amber. E. तृण grass, and मणि a gem; attracting straws, &c.
तृणमत्कुण: तृणमत्कुण m. (-णः) A bail or surety.
तृणराज: तृणराज m. (-जः) A palmyra tree, (Borassus flabelliformis.) E. तृण grass, and राजन् a sovereign, टच् affix, leaving a final vowel.
तृणविस्तर: तृणविस्तर m. (-रः) A heap of grass. E. तृण, and विस्तर expanse.
तृणशीत: तृणशीत n. (-तं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon serratus.) E. तृण grass, and शीत here said to imply abundance.
तृणशून्य: तृणशून्य mfn. subst. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Arabian jasmine. adj. Free from or devoid of grass. n. (-न्यं) The flower of the Ketaki. E. तृण grass, शून्य void of.
तृणषट्पद: तृणषट्पद m. (-दः) A wasp. E. तृण grass, and षट्पद् six-foot; an insect haunting meadows, &c. having six feet.
तृणस: तृणस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Grassy, made, &c. with grass. E. तृण grass, and स aff.
तृणसारा: तृणसारा f. (-रा) The plantain or banana. E. तृण grass, and सार essence, pith.
तृणसिंह: तृणसिंह m. (-हः) An axe. E. तृण grass, and सिंह a lion.
तृणहर्म्म्य: तृणहर्म्म्य m. (-र्म्म्र्यः) A hovel, a house or upper-room of grass or straw. E. तृण grass, and हर्म्म्र्य a mansion.
तृणाग्नि: तृणाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) 1 Conflagration of chaff. 2 Burning a criminal wrapped up in straw. E. तृण grass, and अग्नि fire: see तुषानल.
तृणाञ्जन: तृणाञ्जन m. (-नः) A chameleon, a lizard. E. तृण grass, and अञ्जन a lizard.
तृणेक्षु: तृणेक्षु m. (-क्षुः) A kind of long grass, (Saccharum cylindricum.) E. तृण, and इक्षु sugar cane.
तृणोद्भव: तृणोद्भव m. (-वः) Rice, &c. growing wild or without cultivation. E. तृण grass, and उद्भव produced.
तृणोल्का: तृणोल्का f. (-ल्का) A firebrand made of a wisp of straw. E. तृण grass, and उल्का a firebrand.
तृणौकस्: तृणौकस् n. (-कः) A hovel, a hut, a house of straw or mats. E. तृण grass, and ओकस् abode.
तृणौषध: तृणौषध n. (-धं) A perfume, commonly Elavāluka. E. तृण, and औषध a drug; resembling grass in its appearance.
तृण्या: तृण्या f. (-ण्या) A heap or quantity of grass. E. तृण grass, यत् and टाप् affs.
तृतीय: तृतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Third. f. (-या) The third lunation, the third day of the fortnight. E. त्रि three, तीय affix, and रि changed to the analogous vowel ऋ.
तृतीयक: तृतीयक m. (-कः) A tertian ague. E. कन् added to the last.
तृतीयकज्वर: तृतीयकज्वर m. (-रः) Tertian ague. E. तृतीय, and ज्वर fever.
तृतीयप्रकृति: तृतीयप्रकृति f. (-तिः) 1 A eunuch. 2 The neuter gender: see तृतीयाप्रकृति.
तृतीयाकृत: तृतीयाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thrice ploughed, (a field, &c.) E. तृतीय third, आकृत made, wrought.
तृतीयाप्रकृति: तृतीयाप्रकृति f. (-तिः) 1 A eunuch. 2 The neuter gender. E. तृतीया the third, and प्रकृति nature; neither male nor female, (whose or which;) the compound is more regularly तृतीयप्रकृति.
तृतीयिन्: तृतीयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Having a third. E. तृतीय, and इनि aff.
तृद: तृद (औ इर) औतृदिर् r. 7th cl. (तृणत्ति तृन्ते) 1 To kill, to injure. 2 To disregard. 3 To give. 4 To eat.
तृप: तृप r. 1st cl. (तर्पति) 4th cl. (ञि, उ) ञितृपु (तृप्यति) 5th cl. (तृप्नोति) 6th cl. (तृपति) and 10th cl. (तर्पयति) 1 To please, to satisfy, to content. 2 To be pleased or satisfied, to be content or satiate. 3 (In the 1st and 10th cls.) To light or kindle.
तृपत्: तृपत् m. (-पत्) 1 The moon. 2 A parasol. E. तृप to please, अति Uṇādi affix, deriv. irr.
तृपला: तृपला f. (-ला) A creeper or creeping plant. E. तृप to please, कल Uṇādi aff.
तृप्त: तृप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Contented, satisfied. E. तृप to be pleased, affix क्त.
तृप्तात्मन्: तृप्तात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म्) Contented, satisfied, tranquil. E. तृप्त, and आत्मन् self.
तृप्ति: तृप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Satisfaction, content. E. तृप to please, or be pleased, affix क्तिन्.
तृप्र: तृप्र m. (-प्रः) Ghee or oiled butter. E. तृप to satisfy, Uṇādi affix रक्.
तृप्रालु: तृप्रालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Having ghree, but not liking it or not blending with it. E. तृप, and आलुच् possessive affix; but in this compound implying also aversion.
तृफ: तृफ r. 6th cl. (तृफति) 1 To content, to please. 2 To be pleased or content. 3 To hurt.
तृफला: तृफला f. (-ला) The three myrobalans. E. तृ for त्रि three, फल a fruit, fem. affix टाप्; also त्रिफला.
तृफू: तृफू m. (-फूः) A serpent in general, the serpent genus. E. तृफ to hurt or kill, ऊ Uṇādi aff.
तृम्प: तृम्प r. 6th cl. (तृम्पति) 1 To content, to please. 2 To be pleased or content.
तृम्फ: तृम्फ r. 6th cl. (तृम्फति) 1 To content, to please. 2 To be pleased or content.
तृष: तृष (ञि आ) ञितृषा r. 4th cl. (तृष्यति) 1 To thirst. 2 To thirst metaphorically, to desire, to long for.
तृष्: तृष् f. (तृट्) 1 Thirst. 2 Thirst, (metaphorical,) wish, desire, lust. 3 The daughter of KĀMA, the deity of love. E. तृष to thirst, affix क्विप्; also तृषा, &c.
तृषा: तृषा f. (-षा) 1 Thirst. 2 Wish, desire. 3 The daughter of KĀMA: see the preceding. 4 A plant, (Commelina salicifolia:) see लाङ्गलिकी. E. तृष to thirst, affix क and टाप्; also तृष्णा, तर्षा, &c.
तृषाभू: तृषाभू f. (-भूः) The bladder. E. तृषा thirst, and भू being: whence thirst arises.
तृषार्त: तृषार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-त्ती-र्त्तं) 1 Affected by desire. 2 Thirsty, athirst. E. तृषा, and आर्त्त pained.
तृषार्त्त: तृषार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-त्ती-र्त्तं) 1 Affected by desire. 2 Thirsty, athirst. E. तृषा, and आर्त्त pained.
तृषाह: तृषाह n. (-हं) Water. f. (-हा) A kind of anise: see मधुरिका. E. तृष thirst, आङ् before हन् to destroy or remove, affix ड.
तृषित: तृषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thirsty, thirsting, (physically or metaphorically.) n. (-तं) Thirst, desire. E. तृष to thirst, affix क्त.
तृषितोत्तरा: तृषितोत्तरा f. (-रा) A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia:) see असनपर्णी. E. तृषित thirst, and उत्तर answering.
तृष्णज्: तृष्णज् mfn. (-ष्णक्) Thirsty, (physically or metaphorically,) desiring, longing for, cupidinous. E. तृष to thirst, न added, तृष्ण and जिङ् aff.
तृष्णा: तृष्णा f. (-ष्णा) 1 Thirst. 2 Desire, wish. E. तृषं to thirst, न Uṇādi aff.
तृष्णाक्षय: तृष्णाक्षय m. (-यः) Content, resignation, patience. E. तृष्णा greediness, thirst, and क्षय destruction.
तृष्यत्: तृष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यती-ष्यत्) 1 Thirsting, athirst. 2 Desiring. E. तृष to thirst, and शतृ aff.
तृह: तृह (ऊ) तृहु r. 6th cl. (तृहति) also तृह r. 7th cl. (तृणड्डि) To kill, to hurt, to injure in any manner. (इ) तृहि r. 1st cl. (तृंहति) To grow or increase.
तॄ: तॄ r. 1st cl. (तरति) 1 To pass over or across. 2 To pass or float over, to navigate. 3 To float or swim. 4 To overcome, to surpass. With अव prefixed, To descend, as from heaven. With आङ्, To cross by a boat, &c. With उत्, ^a To pass over or above; ^b To answer. ^c To land, to arrive at the opposite shore. With दुर्, To cross with difficulty. With निर्, To cross safely, to obtain salvation. With प्र, To excel or surpass. With वि, ^a To pass from; ^b To relinquish, to give, to give away, to give alms. With सम्, To swim over.
ते: ते ind. With or by thee. E. ते substituted for त्वया, but not to be confounded with the optional inflection of the 4th and 6th cases of युष्मद् thou.
तेज: तेज r. 1st cl. (तेजति) To guard, to cherish, to defend or protect.
तेज m. (-जः) 1 Sharpness, pungency. 2 Sharpness of a weapon. 3 Brilliancy. 4 Spirit. E. तिज to sharpen, affix घञ्: see तेजस्.
तेजन: तेजन n. (-नं) 1 A bambu. 2 Enlightening, making splendid or polished. 3 Sharpening. f. (-नी) 1 A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides.) 2 Heartpea. E. तिज to sharpen, &c. affix ल्युट्.
तेजनक: तेजनक m. (-कः) A kind of reed, (Saccharum sara.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
तेजपत्र: तेजपत्र n. (-त्रं) The leaf of the Laurus cassia. E. तेज sharp, pungent, and पत्र a leaf.
तेजल: तेजल m. (-लः) The francoline partridge. E. तेज sharpness, ल what gets.
तेजवत्: तेजवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Sharp, pungent. 2 Sharp as a weapon. 3 Bright. 4 Spirited, energetic. f. (-ती) An aromatic plant, (Pothos officinalis:) see गजपिप्पली. E. तेज sharpness, and मतुप् aff.
तेजस्: तेजस् m. (-जाः) A name of Agni or fire. n. (-जः) 1 Splendour, light, lustre. 2 Dignity, consequence. 3 Strength, power. 4 Ardour, spirit, energy. 5 Semen virile. 6 Fresh butter. 7 Impatience, inability to bear or put up with. 8 Gold. 9 Bile,  the bilious humour. 10 Marrow, the brain, &c. 11 Fame, glory. 12 Sharpness, (metallic.) 13 Pungency. 14 Heat. 15 Bodily vigour. 16 Vivacity. E. तिज to sharpen or polish, affix असुन्.
तेजस्कर: तेजस्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Illuminating, making bright. 2 Sharpening, whetting. 3 Invigorating, tonic. E. तेजस् light, &c. and कर what makes.
तेजस्विन्: तेजस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 1 Famous, celebrated. 2 Splendid, &c. see the preceding. f. (-स्विनी) Heartpea: see ज्योतिष्मती. E. तेजस् splendour, &c. विनि aff.
तेजित: तेजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sharpened, whetted, polished, burnished. 2 Excited, invigorated, stimulated. E. तिज to sharpen, and क्त aff.
तेजिष्ठ: तेजिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Very bright or splendid. 2 Vigorous, powerful. E. तेजस्, and इष्ठन् aff.
तेजीयस्: तेजीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Very bright, radiant, splendid. 2 Very powerful or vigorous. E. तेजस्, and ईयसुन् aff.
तेजोमन्थ: तेजोमन्थ m. (-न्थः) A tree, (Premna spinosa:) see गणिकारी. E. तेजस् fire, light, and मन्थ friction; the friction of the wood engendering flame.
तेजोमय: तेजोमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Luminous, brilliant, consisting or made of light. E. तेजस्, मयट् made of.
तेजोरूप: तेजोरूप n. (-पं) 1 The supreme spirit. 2 The nature of light, &c. E. तेजस् light (divine), रूप form.
तेजोवत्: तेजोवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Pungent. 2 Sharp. 3 Bright. 4 Energetic. f. (-ती) 1 A plant bearing a fruit resembling pepper: see गजपिप्पली. 2 A kind of pepper, (Piper chavya, Rox.) E. तेजस् pungency, मतुप् aff.
तेजोवृत्त: तेजोवृत्त n. (-त्तं) Superior brilliancy or power. E. तेजस्, and वृत्त being.
तेन: तेन ind. Therefore, thence, for that reason, on that account, the correlative to येन. E. the third case of तद् that, used as a particle.
तेन m. (-नः) A note or cadence introductory to a song, &c. E. त said to mean GAURI and न ŚIVA; whose favour is secured by this word.
तेप: तेप (ऋ) तेपृ r. 1st cl. (तेपते) 1 To sprinkle, to distil, to ooze or drop. 2 To shake or tremble. 3 To shine.
तेम: तेम m. (-मः) Wet, damp, moisture. E. तिम to be wet, affix घञ्.
तेमन: तेमन n. (-नं) 1 Wetting, moistening, moisture. 2 A sauce or condiment. f. (-नी) A chimney, a fireplace. E. तिम to be or become wet, affix ल्युट्.
तेव: तेव (ऋ) तेवृ r. 1st cl. (तेवते) 1 To play, to sport. 2 To weep or lament.
तेवन: तेवन n. (-नं) 1 A garden, a pleasure garden or play-ground. 2 Play, sport, pastime. E. तेव to play, affix ल्युट्.
तैक्ष्ण्य: तैक्ष्ण्य n. (-क्ष्ण्यं) 1 Sharpness. 2 Heat. 3 Pungency. 4 Fierceness, cruelty. E. तीक्ष्ण, and ष्यञ् aff.
तैजस: तैजस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) 1 Of or relating to fire, fiery, splendid. 2 Powerful, vigorous, intense. n. (-सं) 1 Ghee or oiled butter. 2 Any metal. 3 Intensity. 4 Vigour, energy. E. तेजस् brilliance, affix अण्.
तैजसावर्तिनी: तैजसावर्त्तिनी f. (-नी) A crucible. E. तैजस metal, and आवर्त्तिनी stirring.
तैजसावर्त्तिनी: तैजसावर्त्तिनी f. (-नी) A crucible. E. तैजस metal, and आवर्त्तिनी stirring.
तैतिल: तैतिल m. (-लः) A rhinoceros. n. (-लं) One of the astronomical periods called Karaṇas. E. अण् added to तितिल.
तैत्तिर: तैत्तिर m. (-रः) A francoline partridge. n. (-रं) A flock of partridges. E. तित्तिर, and अण् affix of aggregation or pleonastic.
तैत्तिरीय: तैत्तिरीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating to the Tittiri portion of the Vedas, as a student, a text, teacher, section of, &c. E. तित्तिरि the Yajur Veda so called, and छ affix; or तित्तिरि a partridge, affix as before; the texts of this Veda being disgorged by YĀJÑAVALKYA in a tangible form, and picked up by the rest of VAIŚAMPĀYANA'S disciples, who, for the purpose, assumed the shape of partridges.
तैत्तिरीयक: तैत्तिरीयक m. (-कः) A follower of the Tittiri branch of the Vedas. E. कन् added to the preceding; also इन् being added तैत्तिरीयिन्, &c.
तैग्म्य: तैग्म्य n. (-ग्म्यं) 1 Heat. 2 Sharpness. 3 Pungency. E. तिग्म, and ष्यञ् aff.
तैल: तैल n. (-लं) 1 Oil, expressed oil, prepared from sesamum, mustard, &c. 3 Storax, gum benzoin, incense. E. तिल sesamum, and अण् aff.
तैलक: तैलक n. (-कं) A small quantity of oil. E. तैल, and कन् diminutive affix.
तैलकार: तैलकार m. (-रः) An oil manufacturer. E. तैल, and कार who makes.
तैलकिट्ट: तैलकिट्ट m. (-ट्टं) The oil cake, a cake made of the oily seed, after expression. E. तैल, and किट्ट sediment.
तैलङ्ग: तैलङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The part of the peninsula south of Orissa to Madras, the modern Carnatic.
तैलचौरिका: तैलचौरिका f. (-का) A cockroach. E. तैल oil, चुर to steal, ण्वुल् affix; it is also sometimes read तैलाचारिका from चर to go, with आङ् prefixed, and ण्वुल् aff.
तैलद्रोणी: तैलद्रोणी f. (-णी) A bathing tub for an oil bath. E. तैल, and द्रोणी a bucket.
तैलपक: तैलपक m. (-कः) A cockroach. E. तैल, and पच to digest, अच् aff.
तैलपर्णिक: तैलपर्णिक n. (-कं) White Sandal wood. E. तिलपर्णी Sandal wood, affix कन्.
तैलपर्णी: तैलपर्णी f. (-र्णी) 1 Sandal. 2 Incense. 3 Turpentine. E. तिल sesamum, and पर्ण a leaf, affix अण् and ङीप्.
तैलपा: तैलपा f. (-पा) A cockroach. E. तैल oil, and पा who drinks.
तैलपायिका: तैलपायिका f. (-का) A cockroach. E. तैल oil, पा to drink, ण्वुल् affix, and यक् inserted.
तैलपिपीलिका: तैलपिपीलिका f. (-का) The small red ant. E. तैल, and पिपीलिका an ant.
तैलमाली: तैलमाली f. (-ली) A wick, the cotton of a lamp. E. तैल oil, माला a necklace, ङीप् aff.
तैलम्पात: तैलम्पात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Blending with oil, &c. f. (-ता) Oblation to fire. E. तिल sesamum, पत to go or alight, घञ् affix, and नुम् augment.
तैलसाधन: तैलसाधन n. (-नं) A fragrant substance, (Civet.) E. तैल oil, and साधन menstruum.
तैलस्फटिक: तैलस्फटिक m. (-कः) A sort of gem, (Amber.) E. तैल oil, and स्फटिक crystal.
तैलाटी: तैलाटी f. (-टी) A wasp. E. तैल oil, and अट to go, affixes अण् and ङीप्.
तैलाम्बुका: तैलाम्बुका f. (-का) A cockroach. E. तैल oil, अम्बु water or drink, कन् aff.
तैलिक: तैलिक m. (-कः) An oilman. E. तैल, and ठक् aff.
तैलिन्: तैलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Relating or belonging to oil, oily, &c. m. (-ली) An oilman, an oil grinder or preparer. f. (-लिनी) 1 The wick or cotton of a lamp. 2 A kind of insect found in oil. E. तैल oil, affix इनि.
तैलिशाला: तैलिशाला f. (-ला) An oil mill. E. तैलिन् an oilman, and शाला a house or hall.
तैलीन: तैलीन n. (-नं) A field of sesamum. E. तिल sesamum, and खञ् aff.
तैष: तैष m. (-षः) The month Pauṣa, (December-January.) f. (-त्री) Day of full moon in Pauṣa. E. तिष्य the constellation, (in which the moon is full in this month,) and अण् affix; य is dropped.
तोक: तोक n. (-कं) A child, a son or a daughter, male or female offspring. E. तु a Sautra root, to increase, affix क, deriv. irr. also तोककं.
तोक्म: तोक्म m. (-क्मः) 1 Green or unripe barley. 2 Green, (the colour.) n. (-क्मं) 1 The wax of the ear. 2 A cloud. E. तक to deride, म affix, and ओ substituted for the radical vowel; it is also written तोक्य.
तोटक: तोटक n. (-कं) A measure of verse, a stanza, each line containing twelve syllables.
तोड: तोड r. 1st cl. (ऋ) तोडृ (तोडति) To treat with disrespect.
तोत्र: तोत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A stick or bambu, with a sharp iron head, used for guiding an elephant. 2 A goad or pike for driving cattle. E. तुद to vex, to goad, affix ष्ट्रन्; also तोदन.
तोत्रवेत्र: तोत्रवेत्र n. (-त्रं) A rod or wand carried by VIṢṆU. E. तोत्र a goad, and वेत्र a stick.
तोद: तोद m. (-दः) 1 Pain, anguish, vexation, torture, uneasiness, (either of body or mind.) 2 Sharp, shooting or pricking pain. E. तुद to tease or torment, affix घञ्.
तोदन: तोदन n. (-नं) 1 A goad: see तोत्र. 2 Pain, affliction from disease, &c. E. तुद to give pain, affix ल्युट्.
तोमर: तोमर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 An iron club or crow. 2 A lance. E. तु Sautra root, to hurt, affix विच्, तु that which injures, मृ to die, affix अच्, and the vowel of तु changed.
तोमरग्रह: तोमरग्रह m. (-हः) A warrior armed with a club. E. तोमर, and ग्रह who takes.
तोमरधर: तोमरधर m. (-रः) 1 A name of Agni. 2 A warrior armed with a club. E. तोमर an iron club, and धर having.
तोमरिका: तोमरिका f. (-का) A fragrant earth: see तुवरिका.
तोय: तोय n. (-यं) Water. E. तु to surround, Uṇādi affix कोय or ताय to nourish, अच् affix, and आ changed irregularly to ओ.
तोयकाम: तोयकाम m. (-मः) A sort of cane growing in or near water, (Calamus fasciculatus, Rox.) E. तोय water, and काम desiring, affecting.
तोयकृच्छ्र: तोयकृच्छ्र m. (-च्छ्रः) A sort of penance, drinking nothing but water for a fixed period. E. तोय water, and कच्छ्र penance.
तोयडिम्भ: तोयडिम्भ m. (-म्भः) Hail. E. तोय water, and डिम्भ young; also तायडिम्भक.
तोयद: तोयद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who or what gives water. m. (-दः) 1 A cloud. 2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) n. (-दं) Ghee or oiled butter. E. तोय water, and द yielding.
तोयधर: तोयधर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Having or containing water. m. (-रः) 1 A cloud. 2 A fragrant grass: see मुस्तक. 3 A potherb, (Marsilia dentata.) E. तोय water, and धर possessing.
तोयधि: तोयधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. तोय water, and धि having.
तोयधिप्रिय: तोयधिप्रिय m. (-यः) Cloves. E. तोयधि the sea, and प्रिय fond of; produced in maritime countries.
तोयनिधि: तोयनिधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. तोय water, and निधि nest or receptacle.
तोयपिप्पली: तोयपिप्पली f. (-ली) A plant, (Jussieua repens.) E. तोय water, and पिप्पली long pepper.
तोयपुष्पी: तोयपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) Trumpet flower. E. तोय water, and पुष्प a flower; flowering near water.
तोयप्रसादन: तोयप्रसादन n. (-नं) The clearing nut plant, (Strychnos potatorum.) E. तोय water, and प्रसादन clearing, cleansing; the nut being rubbed upon the inside of a water jar, occasions the precipitation of the impurities of the water poured into it.
तोयप्रसादनफल: तोयप्रसादनफल n. (-लं) The clearing nut: see the preceding. E. तोयप्रसादन as above, and फल fruit.
तोयवल्ली: तोयवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A kind of gourd, (Momordica charantia.) E. तोय water, and वल्ली a creeper.
तोयशुक्तिका: तोयशुक्तिका f. (-का) An oyster. E. तोय, and शुक्तिका an oyster.
तोयसूचक: तोयसूचक m. (-कः) A frog. E. तोय water, and सूचक a spy.
तोयाधिवासिनी: तोयाधिवासिनी f. (-नी) Trumpet flower. E. तोय water, अधि upon or near, वस to abide, णिनि and ङीप् affs.
तोरण: तोरण mn. (-णः-णं) 1 The ornamented arch of a door or gateway. 2 An outer door. 3 Decoration of the gate post. 4 A temporary and ornamental arch. 5 A mound or raised mark near a bathing place. 6 A triangle supporting a large balance. n. (-णं) The neck, the throat. E. तुर to hasten, affix ल्युट्; by which people pass or go.
तोल: तोल mn. (-लः-लं) A Tola, a weight of gold or silver: it is stated in books at 16 Māṣas of 5 Rattis or 6½ grains each, and weighs therefore 105 grains troy: in practice it is calculated at 12 Māṣas jeweller's weight, and weighs nearly double, or 210 grains; but actually it is of the same weight as the Sicca or grs. 179(2/3). E. तुल to weigh, affix घञ्; also with ण्वुल् affix तोलक, mn. (-कः-कं.)
तोलन: तोलन n. (-नं) Weighing. E. तुल to weigh, ल्युट् aff.
तोलयित्वा: तोलयित्वा ind. Having weighed. E. तुल to weigh, causal form, त्त्वा aff.
तोष: तोष n. (-षं) Pleasure, joy, happiness. E. तुष to be pleased, affix घञ्.
तोषित: तोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pleased, appeased. E. तुष to be pleased, affix क्त.
तौक: तौक (ऋ) तौकृ r. 1st cl. (तौकते) To go or move.
तौतिक: तौतिक n. (-कं) A pearl. m. (-कः) The pearl oyster.
तौर्य: तौर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) The sound of musical instruments, harmony, &c. E. तूर्य्य an instrument, and अण् aff.
तौर्य्य: तौर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) The sound of musical instruments, harmony, &c. E. तूर्य्य an instrument, and अण् aff.
तौर्यत्रिक: तौर्य्यत्रिक n. (-कं) Symphony, union of song, dance, and instrumental music. E. तौर्य्य as above, त्रि three, कन् affix; triple or threefold melody.
तौर्य्यत्रिक: तौर्य्यत्रिक n. (-कं) Symphony, union of song, dance, and instrumental music. E. तौर्य्य as above, त्रि three, कन् affix; triple or threefold melody.
तौल: तौल n. (-लं) A balance. E. तुला, अण् pleonasm.
तौलिक: तौलिक m. (-कः) A painter. E. तुलिका a brush, and अण् aff.
तौलिकिक: तौलिकिक m. (-कः) A painter. E. तुलिका a brush or pencil, and ठक् aff.
तौषार: तौषार n. (-रं) 1 Snow. 2 Cold. E. तुषार frost, and अण् aff.
त्यक्त: त्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Left, resigned, abandoned, deserted, &c. E. त्यज to quit, affix क्त.
त्यक्तजीवित: त्यक्तजीवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ready to die; willing to run all hazards, having relinquished the expectation of life as men on the forlorn hope. E. त्यक्त left, and जीवित life.
त्यक्तवत्: त्यक्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Leaving, abandoning. E. त्यज to quit, क्तवतु aff.
त्यक्तव्य: त्यक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be left, abandoned, excepted, &c. E. त्यज, and तव्य aff.
त्यक्ताग्नि: त्यक्ताग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A Brahman who has lost his household fire, one who neglects essential ceremonies. E. त्यक्त, and अग्नि fire.
त्यक्तुकाम: त्यक्तुकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Wishing to leave. E. त्यक्तु for the infin. त्यक्तुं, and काम desiring.
त्यक्त्वा: त्यक्त्वा ind. Having left or abandoned. E. त्यज, and क्त्वा aff.
त्यज: त्यज r. 1st cl. (औ) त्यजौ (त्यजति) To quit, to abandon, to leave or resign, to part from, to give away.
त्यजन: त्यजन n. (-नं) 1 Leaving, quitting, abandoning. 2 Excepting, exclusion. 3 Giving. E. त्यज, and ल्युट् aff.
त्यजनीय: त्यजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be left or abandoned. 2 To be avoided. 3 To be excepted. E. त्यज, and अनीयर् aff.
त्यद्: त्यद् pron. for तद् mfn. (स्यः-स्या-तद्) That. E. त्यज to quit, Uṇādi affix अदि, and the final of the radical rejected.
त्याग: त्याग m. (-गः) 1 Gift, donation. 2 Abandoning, leaving, parting from, separation, deserting, &c. 3 A sage, one who separates himself from worldly thoughts. E. त्यज to abandon, घञ् aff.
त्यागशील: त्यागशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Generous, liberal. E. त्याग, and शील addicted to.
त्यागशीलता: त्यागशीलता f. (-ता) Generosity. E. त्यागशील, and तल् affix; also with त्व, त्यागशीलत्वं.
त्यागिता: त्यागिता f. (-ता) Liberality, generosity. E. त्यागिन्, and तल् affix; also with त्व affix, त्यागित्वं.
त्यागिन्: त्यागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Who or what leaves, gives, excepts, &c. m. (-गी) A giver, a donor. 2 A hero. 3 An abandoner, a deserter, but chiefly applied to the religious ascetic, or him who abandons terrestrial objects, thoughts, passions, &c. E. त्याग as above, इनि aff.
त्यागिम: त्यागिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Left, abandoned. E. त्याग leaving, इमच् aff.
त्याज्य: त्याज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) 1 To be left or avoided. 2 To be abstained from. 3 To be given. 4 To be excepted. n. (-ज्यं) Part of an asterism, or its duration considered as unlucky. E. त्यज to leave, affix ण्यत्.
त्रक: त्रक (इ) त्रकि r. 1st cl. (त्रङ्कते) To go or move.
त्रख: त्रख (इ) त्रखि r. 1st cl. (त्रङ्खति) To go or move.
त्रग: त्रग (इ) त्रगि r. 1st cl. (त्रङ्गति) To go or move.
त्रङ्ग: त्रङ्ग mf. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा) The city of HARIŚCANDRA, suspended, it is supposed, in the air. E. त्रै to fear, affix क्विप्, and ग what goes; what imparts terror.
त्रद: त्रद (इ) त्रदि r. 1st cl. (त्रन्दति) 1 To act, to perform functions. 2 To endeavour, to strive. 3 To be busy.
त्रप: त्रप (ऊ, ष) त्रपूष् r. 1st cl. (त्रपति) To be modest, to be ashamed.
त्रप mf. (-पः-पा) Shame, modesty, bashfulness. f. (-पा) 1 An unchaste woman, (a shame to her family.) 2 Family, race. 3 Fame, celebrity. E. त्रप to be modest, affix अङ्, fem. affix टाप्.
त्रपमाण: त्रपमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being ashamed. E. त्रप्र to be ashamed, शानच् aff.
त्रपाक: त्रपाक m. (-कः) A barbarian of a certain description. E. त्रप to be modest, आकन् Uṇādi aff.
त्रपानिरस्त: त्रपानिरस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Shameless, impudent. E. त्रपा, and निरस्त expelled.
त्रपान्वित: त्रपान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Modest, bashful, ashamed. E. त्रपा, and अन्वित possessed of.
त्रपाभर: त्रपाभर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Overcome with shame. E. त्रपा, and भर having.
त्रपायुक्त: त्रपायुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Bashful, modest. E. त्रपा, and युक्त attached.
त्रपारण्डा: त्रपारण्डा f. (-ण्डा) A whore, a harlot. E. त्रपा shame, लडि to reject, affix अच् and टाप्, and ल changed to र.
त्रपावत्: त्रपावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Modest, ashamed. E. त्रपा, and मतुप् aff.
त्रपाहीन: त्रपाहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Immodest, impudent. E. त्रपा, and हीन void of.
त्रपित: त्रपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Modest, bashful, ashamed. E. त्रप to be modest, क्त aff.
त्रपिष्ठ: त्रपिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Highly satisfied. 2 Very much ashamed. E. तृप to please, or त्रपा shame, and इष्ठन् affix, deriv. irr.
त्रपीयस्: त्रपीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Highly or excessively pleased or content. 2 Very much ashamed. E. तृप to be pleased, or तृपा and इयसुन् affix of the irr. superlative.
त्रपु: त्रपु n. (-पुः) 1 Tin. 2 Lead. E. त्रप to be modest, Uṇādi affix उ.
त्रपुल: त्रपुल n. (-लं) Tin. E. लच् added to the preceding.
त्रपुष: त्रपुष mf. (-षं-षी) A cucumber. n. (-षं) Tin. E. त्रप to be ashamed, &c. उसस् affix, fem. ङीष्.
त्रपुस्: त्रपुस् n. (-पुः) Tin, or according to some, lead: see त्रपु. E. त्रप to be ashamed, Uṇādi affix उस्.
त्रप्सा: त्रप्सा n. (-प्स्यं) Thin or diluted curds. E. तृप to be satisfied, deriv. irr.; also without the final य, त्रप्स, n. (-प्सं) also द्रप्स्य and द्रप्सा.
त्रय: त्रय nf. (-यं-यी) 1 The third. 2 (In composition) Three, as गुणत्रयं the three properties. E. त्रि, टयप् aff.
त्रयी: त्रयी f. (-यी) 1 The three Vedas collectively, that is, omitting the Atharvan, which not being a text book for the customary religious rites of the Hindus, is considered very commonly rather as an appendix to the other three, than a fourth work of equal authority. A matron, a married woman who has children living. 3 Intellect, understanding. 4 A plant, (Conyza serratula.) E. त्रि three, अयप् or टयप् substituted for the final, fem. affix ङीप्.
त्रयीतनु: त्रयीतनु m. (-नुः) The sun. E. त्रयी the three Vedas, and तनु diffusion; celebrated through these sacred books, or because the Sāma Veda, and portions of the other Vedas, are said to have proceeded from the sun.
त्रयीधर्म: त्रयीधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Duty enjoined by the Vedas, modes of sacrifice, &c. prescribed by them. E. त्रयी the three Vedas, and धर्म्म virtue.
त्रयीधर्म्म: त्रयीधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Duty enjoined by the Vedas, modes of sacrifice, &c. prescribed by them. E. त्रयी the three Vedas, and धर्म्म virtue.
त्रयीमुख: त्रयीमुख m. (-खः) A Brahman. E. त्रयी the Vedas, and मुख the mouth.
त्रयोदश: त्रयोदश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Thirteenth. f. (-शी) The thirteenth day of the lunar fortnight: see the next.
त्रयोदशन्: त्रयोदशन् mfn. plu. (-श) Thirteen. E. त्रयस् for त्रि three, and दशन् ten.
त्रस: त्रस (ई) त्रसी r. 1st and 4th cl. (त्रसति त्रस्यति) 1 To fear, to be afraid. 2 To run, to go quickly. (इ) त्रसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (त्रंसति त्रंसयति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine. Also त्रस r. 10th cl. (त्रासयति) 1 To hold. 2 To seize or take. 3 To oppose, to prevent or forbid. 4 To frighten.
त्रस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Moveable, loco-motive. n. (-सं) A wood, a forest. E. त्रस to go, affix अच्.
त्रसर: त्रसर m. (-रः) 1 A shuttle. 2 Weaving. E. त्रस to go, affix अरच्.
त्रसरेणु: त्रसरेणु mf. (-णुः) An atom or mote visible in a sunbeam, especially considered as an ideal weight, either of the lowest denomination, or equal to three, or according to some, thirty invisible atoms. f. (-णुः) A wife of the sun. E. त्रस moveable, and रेणु dust; also read त्र्यमरेणु.
त्रसुर: त्रसुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Timid, fearful. E. त्रस to fear, उरच् aff.
त्रस्त: त्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Timid, fearful. 2 Frighted, alarmed. 3 Quick. E. त्रस to fear, affix क्त; also त्रस्नु.
